Lithium batteries, electric motors, and photovoltaic solar panels were all invented here; 85 percent of the world's solar market was based in the U.S. And there was bipartisan political will to begin prioritizing non-fossil fuel energy sources. "Those who think we are powerless to do anything about the greenhouse effect forget about the 'White House effect,'" George H. W. Bush in a campaign speech after becoming the Republican nominee for president. "In my first year in office, I will convene a global conference on the environment at the White House. It will include the Soviets, the Chinese. ... The agenda will be clear. We will talk about global warming." ? The notion then was that the U.S. would have to drag China into cooperating. At that time, renewable energy was essentially nonexistent in China. In fact, the Communist government did not articulate clear goals for expanding its domestic clean energy industry until the release of its Twelfth Five-Year Plan, in 2010, when for the first time it the fight against climate change as a major challenge. That year, China had combined wind and solar capacity than the U.S. Just a decade and a half later, China is 92 percent of the world's solar panels, 82 percent of the world's wind turbines, and of the world's batteries. This dominance has dramatically reduced costs--Chinese solar panel prices dropped 40 percent in 2023 alone, and China's BYD, the EV manufacturer, now sells high-quality EVs for just $10,000--and sparked a clean energy explosion across the globe. It took from 1954 to 2022 for humanity to install one terawatt of solar capacity. Just two years later, in 2024, the world hit two terawatts. Pakistan went from basically zero solar capacity to 25 percent of all its electricity coming from solar in just a few years, with solar panel imports from China doubling between 2023 and 2024. Algeria imported 630 times more Chinese solar panels in the first half of 2025 than it had in 2024. So it took less than 15 years for one global power (and not even the wealthiest or most technologically advanced one) to create a global energy market in which renewables are outcompeting fossil fuels, despite the in economic and political subsidies that continue to structurally advantage oil and gas in profound ways. Meanwhile, 37 years after it seemed poised to dominate the clean energy transition, the U.S. has become a full-on petrostate. So what happened? The Conspiracy Here is where we see the most significant independent variable in the comparison between the U.S. and China--the response of their respective fossil fuel industries. Unlike China's state-run coal companies, which never attacked climate science, in the U.S., Big Oil began implementing a massive scheme to poison the public with climate denial in order to, as one 1988 internal Exxon put it, block the "development of nonfossil fuel resources." And that's just what they did. In 1991, a group of fossil fuel companies founded the to "Reposition global warming as theory (not fact)." ICE conducted polling that found that 80 percent of Americans thought that the problem of climate change was serious. To dismantle this consensus, ICE planned to target "not typically active information-seekers" with climate denying radio commercials, public relations tours, mailers, and newspaper advertisements featuring messages like, "Who told you the Earth was warming... Chicken Little?" In 1998, representatives from major fossil fuel companies produced the "," which outlined a multimillion-dollar campaign to make climate denial "part of the 'conventional wisdom'" and laid out a series of strategies designed to flood Americans with false claims that there was no scientific consensus about the reality of climate change. These tactics included buying off "independent" scientists to spread climate denial, "advertising the scientific uncertainties" in various markets, and distributing their propaganda "directly to schools"--all tactics the fossil fuel industry went on to execute in the United States and across Europe. Legal Accountability Today, this decades-long campaign to fraudulently turn the public against climate action is the subject of dozens of lawsuits against oil companies by plaintiffs seeking damages for climate harms. These suits have great promise. But they also face , as you'd expect when taking on the most powerful corporations in the world. One of the top arguments the fossil fuel industry has used to try to evade accountability for their fraud relates to causation. To hold a defendant liable for misconduct, a plaintiff has to demonstrate that the defendant's actions were a substantial factor in causing harm to the plaintiff. Big Oil's army of lawyers are quick to claim that, even if the fossil fuel industry did lie about climate change, plaintiffs cannot prove that these lies necessarily played a substantial role in driving climate damages. There are different ways to try to demonstrate the causal impact of Big Oil's deception. You can compare the actual scientific consensus on climate with the public's perception of that consensus. The most recent of the peer-reviewed scientific literature found that there is greater than 99 percent agreement on the existence and causes of man-made climate change, yet a 2015 Yale-George Mason University found that only one in ten Americans understands this. As the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) in its sixth assessment report, "misinformation and politicization of climate change science has created polarization in public and policy domains in North America, particularly in the US, limiting climate action," which, in turn, "inflates climate risks." But the recent history of clean energy development in China offers another compelling piece of evidence for this causal link. After all, causation is essentially determined by asking, "What would have happened if the conduct at issue had not occurred?" China provides that counterfactual. On the one hand, we have a superpower, the U.S., that was primed with every advantage to begin developing clean energy economies of scale more than three decades ago, but instead doubled down as a petrostate after its fossil fuel industry fraudulently polarized a substantial portion of its population against climate action. On the other hand, we have China--the one superpower in the world where those western Big Oil companies don't have influence and were not able to poison the well with their deception--which has in just a few years succeeded in remaking the global energy system such that renewables are now cheaper than fossil fuels. Race Against Time It's important to note this timescale, because the fight against climate change is fundamentally a race against time. And it's a race that humanity is losing badly, as evidenced by the terrifying recent that the Earth has reached its first catastrophic climate tipping point--coral reefs have entered terminal decline, condemning vast swathes of the planet's biodiversity and the livelihoods of hundreds of millions--and is on the brink of several others, including the destruction of the Amazon, the collapse of global ocean currents, and the loss of polar ice sheets. The speed of the world's renewable energy explosion following the prioritization of clean energy by a single global power proves that this dystopian timeline was far from inevitable. Absent Big Oil's climate fraud, it is likely that the West could have achieved these clean energy milestones decades earlier, giving humanity more than enough time to transition off of fossil fuels before we hit the apocalyptic tipping points we are currently hurtling towards. In other words, Big Oil's lies did cause--or at the very least were a substantial factor in causing--the catastrophic climate harms we are experiencing today. Of course, no historical counterfactual can be absolutely definitive. There are obviously many differences between the U.S. in the 1990s and China in the 2010s beyond the presence or absence of fossil fuel-funded campaigns of climate deception. But none of these differences strongly cut against the causation analysis. For example, you could argue that China, with its system of state control, could direct resources toward clean energy in a way the U.S. never could have. But the U.S. can clearly marshal vast resources for its priorities (think of the interstate highway system, the Apollo program, or the development of AI data centers) and had far more resources to marshal; in 2010, when China began its renewables buildout, its GDP was just over one third that of the U.S. You could also argue that it's just not possible to compare what might have happened in the democratic U.S. to what did occur in the single-party autocracy of China. # _Opinion:_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76a95943-c7f0-4de4-8434-d147aa99b929?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**By Charles Sauer

** With more than **[7 million Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/c4090459-cca8-4977-a79d-2e1698b933da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** living with Alzheimer's - a number expected to double by 2050 - voters are grappling with the emotional and financial costs of caring for aging loved ones.
For Republicans seeking to lead with principled, compassionate, and fiscally responsible health policy, this crisis presents a clear opportunity: be the party that takes seniors' concerns seriously.
On Alzheimer's, good policy is good politics. According to new **[polling](https://substack.com/redirect/3a4715bf-f945-490c-9f77-eeafe0426e0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , Republicans could go from a 3-point deficit in a congressional race to a 19-point lead over Democrats by stepping up the fight against Alzheimer's. In fact, 87% of voters say they would credit President Trump with "a major achievement" if he were to support these policies.
To show voters they are serious about Alzheimer's, Republicans should focus on two strategic buckets: incentivize early detection and remove bureaucratic barriers to treatment and diagnosis. These reforms would not only help American families - they would also deliver major political returns.
Republicans' first, and perhaps most urgent, reform should be removing Medicare's barriers to new Alzheimer's treatments.
Two FDA-approved treatments remove toxic proteins from the brain and slow the disease, giving patients more time to live independently. It is **[incredibly difficult](https://substack.com/redirect/90efed15-30cc-41f6-9e60-0113701a5235?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for a new drug to gain FDA approval, with only 10% of new therapies succeeding. Yet under Biden, instead of honoring the FDA's scientific judgment, Medicare took an unprecedented step to tie these treatments up in a program that serves no purpose except to increase the administrative burden for doctors. To prescribe the drugs, doctors have to submit patient data to a national registry - an exercise in bureaucracy more fit for countries with socialized medicine, not America.
Smaller practices, especially those in rural areas, are already stretched thin and can't spare staff time for needless paperwork. It's a disincentive that is preventing patients from getting care they need. Even worse, private insurers are using Medicare's program designation to reject claims, deeming these treatments "experimental." This affects younger people with Alzheimer's in their 50s and even 40s who tend to have employer-sponsored insurance and would benefit most from early intervention.
Medicare's duplicative oversight doesn't protect patients - it punishes them. Republicans should push for Medicare to lift unnecessary barriers to treatment, particularly when the FDA has already determined a treatment's safety and efficacy. Voters would back them; 92% support changing Medicare rules to make it easier for patients to receive FDA-approved Alzheimer's treatments.
Second, policymakers should look at ways to incentivize early detection.
With chronic issues like dementia, early detection and prevention is always better - and more cost effective - than treatment. It keeps patients out of the hospital and long-term care facilities, saving taxpayers money.
Proactive measures like the heart-healthy "**[Mediterranean-DASH Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay](https://substack.com/redirect/81facbcf-c61b-451a-9885-81089057b8aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** " diet alongside **[sufficient sleep and exercise](https://substack.com/redirect/73fe1a46-e5fe-417e-9b12-0a834d7fa76b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** are proven to preserve cognitive abilities and may help reduce Alzheimer's risk, but early detection is crucial.
Today, early detection of Alzheimer's disease is now possible. Advanced blood-based biomarker tests approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) can detect levels of disease-causing proteins in the brain with up to **[90% accuracy](https://substack.com/redirect/a1f4be30-a9c4-4b63-9ca6-d37b7b11d6a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).** In the future, they will help to diagnose Alzheimer's before symptoms are evident. They can open up early detection to the 70 million Americans on Medicare.
This isn't just responsible policy - it's popular with voters. About 80% of voters believe early detection and prevention of Alzheimer's would save taxpayers billions, and 90% support requiring Medicare to cover diagnostic blood tests.
Almost 40% of voters in battleground congressional districts have family members or friends affected by Alzheimer's. These voters are looking to the party that can make a real difference in the war against Alzheimer's. Republicans can - and should - be that party. By focusing on prevention, early diagnosis, and CMS reform, they can offer a message of common sense and compassion.

The question isn't whether we can afford to act on Alzheimer's. It's whether we can afford not to.

The question isn't whether we can afford to act on Alzheimer's. It's whether we can afford not to... | | | Oct 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | Opinion: | | ---|---|--- By Charles Sauer With more than living with Alzheimer's - a number expected to double by 2050 - voters are grappling with the emotional and financial costs of caring for aging loved ones. For Republicans seeking to lead with principled, compassionate, and fiscally responsible health policy, this crisis presents a clear opportunity: be the party that takes seniors' concerns seriously. On Alzheimer's, good policy is good politics. According to new , Republicans could go from a 3-point deficit in a congressional race to a 19-point lead over Democrats by stepping up the fight against Alzheimer's. In fact, 87% of voters say they would credit President Trump with "a major achievement" if he were to support these policies. To show voters they are serious about Alzheimer's, Republicans should focus on two strategic buckets: incentivize early detection and remove bureaucratic barriers to treatment and diagnosis. These reforms would not only help American families - they would also deliver major political returns. Republicans' first, and perhaps most urgent, reform should be removing Medicare's barriers to new Alzheimer's treatments. Two FDA-approved treatments remove toxic proteins from the brain and slow the disease, giving patients more time to live independently. It is for a new drug to gain FDA approval, with only 10% of new therapies succeeding. Yet under Biden, instead of honoring the FDA's scientific judgment, Medicare took an unprecedented step to tie these treatments up in a program that serves no purpose except to increase the administrative burden for doctors. To prescribe the drugs, doctors have to submit patient data to a national registry - an exercise in bureaucracy more fit for countries with socialized medicine, not America. Smaller practices, especially those in rural areas, are already stretched thin and can't spare staff time for needless paperwork. It's a disincentive that is preventing patients from getting care they need. Even worse, private insurers are using Medicare's program designation to reject claims, deeming these treatments "experimental." This affects younger people with Alzheimer's in their 50s and even 40s who tend to have employer-sponsored insurance and would benefit most from early intervention. Medicare's duplicative oversight doesn't protect patients - it punishes them. Republicans should push for Medicare to lift unnecessary barriers to treatment, particularly when the FDA has already determined a treatment's safety and efficacy. Voters would back them; 92% support changing Medicare rules to make it easier for patients to receive FDA-approved Alzheimer's treatments. Second, policymakers should look at ways to incentivize early detection. With chronic issues like dementia, early detection and prevention is always better - and more cost effective - than treatment. It keeps patients out of the hospital and long-term care facilities, saving taxpayers money. Proactive measures like the heart-healthy " " diet alongside are proven to preserve cognitive abilities and may help reduce Alzheimer's risk, but early detection is crucial. Today, early detection of Alzheimer's disease is now possible. Advanced blood-based biomarker tests approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) can detect levels of disease-causing proteins in the brain with up to . In the future, they will help to diagnose Alzheimer's before symptoms are evident. They can open up early detection to the 70 million Americans on Medicare. This isn't just responsible policy - it's popular with voters. About 80% of voters believe early detection and prevention of Alzheimer's would save taxpayers billions, and 90% support requiring Medicare to cover diagnostic blood tests. Almost 40% of voters in battleground congressional districts have family members or friends affected by Alzheimer's. These voters are looking to the party that can make a real difference in the war against Alzheimer's. Republicans can - and should - be that party. By focusing on prevention, early diagnosis, and CMS reform, they can offer a message of common sense and compassion. The question isn't whether we can afford to act on Alzheimer's. It's whether we can afford not to. Charles Sauer is the president of the Market Institute, and the author of Profit Motive: What Drives the Things We Do. clean_body: This problem is NOT solved| | | | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot,How many laws has Congress passed to make the Trump policies that secured the border permanent?NONE! And I’m writing to you today because we have got to face the facts:The immigration crisis is NOT over. The problem is NOT solved. My friend, you see it and I see it: too many Americans believe we no longer need to fight.They think because President Trump has closed the border, reactivated ICE, and launched a historic deportation effort, that it’s time to relax.Wrong! President Trump said it himself: “They want to do open borders. If they ever got in...they would open up the border in 2 minutes.” That’s as true as it is terrifying. And the most dangerous part is that if they get the chance the radical Left WILL open the border back up, and they WILL make THEIR border policies permanent. We have GOT to beat them to it—Right now, while we have the chance. Congress must act, quickly and strongly. My friend, we’ve seen the immigration pendulum swing back and forth for years.At the end of President Trump’s first term, the border was closed... Then on Day One of the Biden Administration, he reversed every Trump policy and opened the border wide again...Then on Day One of the second Trump Administration, closed again!That’s what happens when Congress fails to lock in real reform.The border gets closed... then opened. Closed... then opened again. It’s time to stop the mindless game of hot potato.It’s time to end the crisis once and for all, forever!That’s why NumbersUSA is fighting tooth and nail to pass H.R. 2—the Secure the Border Act.With H.R. 2 we can make the bulk of the Trump policies permanent in one fell swoop!H.R. 2 would: Keep “Remain in Mexico” in place so migrants can’t flood across our border. Mandate E-Verify nationwide to stop illegal hiring and restore jobs for American workers. Crack down on visa overstays that let illegal immigrants slip through the system. Permanently restore enforcement tools that Biden dismantled. And much more!This may be the single strongest border security bill ever introduced.And it’s the legislation the Left fears most. Because they know it would destroy their decades-long plan to use open borders to reshape America—our elections, our values, and our future.But they will do everything in their power to stop it. My friend, my name is Michael Hough, and I’m the Co-President of NumbersUSA. For nearly 30 years, NumbersUSA has been leading the fight for real immigration reform.We’re not talkers—we’re doers.While billionaire-backed “think tanks” sit on the sidelines, NumbersUSA leads a grassroots army of 8 million Americans fighting to make immigration reform happen. We send millions of messages to Congress each year demanding action—and we do it at the lowest cost possible. On average, each message costs just $0.25. Your gift of $50 sends 200 messages. Every message increases the pressure. Every dollar fuels the fight.And when you give to NumbersUSA, you’re joining the premier organization for sensible immigration action.Every supporter like you helps us push Congress to finally do their job. So please—don’t fall complacent. President Trump has done so much to secure the border—but unless Congress acts, everything we’ve gained can vanish in an instant.The Left will fight back ruthlessly.They want open borders, illegal alien voting, free healthcare for illegals, and permanent power. When you support NumbersUSA, you’re not funding talk. You’re funding results. You’re helping lead the charge to make Trump’s immigration policies permanent and end the crisis once and for all. I hope you’ll join us in this fight today.Because the truth is clear:The immigration crisis is not over. If we don’t act, the pendulum will keep swinging, and our border will be wide open again 2 minutes after the radical Left regains power. # Meku! (Hello)
---
Hey everyone, It's a powerful season for 7 Directions of Service. Before we head to COP30 we invite you to join us for our **4th annual Truthsgiving** on **November 2 at The Fruit in Durham, NC** , featuring **Chef Kam Watkins (Occaneechi Saponi)** , storytelling, performances, and the **premiere of _VS Goliath: Episode 2_** , a powerful film following communities--including Crystal and Jason--fighting the **Mountain Valley Pipeline** across Appalachia. Crystal and Jason will journey to **Bel em, Brazil, for COP30**, the 2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference, where they'll present our work on **Rights of Nature and environmental justice** at the international level. While in Brazil at COP30, we will release our **Water Report for the Occaneechi Community in the Piedmont** , highlighting critical water and health issues in our homelands. =We're also excited to launch our **new Rights of Nature course** on Teachable--an accessible, self-paced introduction to Indigenous-led climate solutions.
---
# **What's in our water in the Occaneechi-Saponi Community?**
---
|
---
On November 10, we'll release a report in Belem on the water quality and environmental health of the Occaneechi community in the Piedmont, so please stay tuned. While at COP30, we'll be meeting with grassroots global organizations at the United Nations to discuss community-led climate justice, because change is inevitable, but justice is not. There is growing evidence that place-based Just Transition strategies--led by communities and workers--are the most effective pathways to decarbonize our economies, reduce toxic pollution, and create sustainable local jobs. Our biggest event will take place on November 11, when we present our judgment to the international community and the United Nations on the violation of the Rights of Rivers and the Rights of Nature by the Mountain Valley Pipeline and MVP Southgate, during the 6th International Rights of Nature Tribunal: "A New Pledge for Mother Nature." This session will include my presentation
---
**Finish the Journey with the conclusion for the Rights of Nature Tribunal against the Mountain Valley Pipeline at COP30 in Belem, Brazil.**
---
|
---
We will present our judgment to the international community and the United Nations on the violation of the Rights of Rivers and the Rights of Nature by the Mountain Valley Pipeline and MVP Southgate during the 6th International Rights of Nature Tribunal: "A New Pledge for Mother Nature." _" Fossil Fuel Expansion in the USA: The MVP Case and Judgment,"_ and will culminate with the signing of _A New Pledge for Mother Nature_ , a policy document urging the UN and the global community to ensure a livable future for all beings. You can register to attend online or in person here: [Register Link](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwocC6bqm2PJCZBjzjEPv1gY-8I-PdlUhR-uDPtqJAMBy-VhpB-WoITc9j8cOr1pyCOFT3ThJqsPXxpIlX64p2uQ1vmwc7UzX9BhlTyXmDBaxczHuOuoa0rL3GG6HgdAduYyzPB4woAsrZhvpDLXXl9ON0i38cq6xor0jwOj08OFiozlJ1DXhfOucawnN0kS2toyKrgjQlAyyjV75K7BwKi7BZ1fdD9-lQRRsPOMZeq3PEsi8vnMuqmyxgPBDlINsER9bFvWg4QuKc60hRgJc1Jee_UUhp_CqqTv7WQ19OGttwvaOnuiljwhciCvTxYjO71G8wSEhuwRZ1-mCuQ62etuQdbyaJKoEItb4tB1LSPShwHbBhfRx3gryONzE0CIRZZUyPbGYlR-kyE2nQJYgz5kidRaCCfJDO4KGkrNdQkjEhNdZ8D9TVaZPn_8yLoHM0rogcPVdmPPOOPN-f2NMaOp7e-aH-tVtPlUbb-zNyg9JORPC7rv7CnF3OUH2eHeIf0poJmik1N-Hb7MQjWS0F89R22WECu75BrGYala6a_lP4ftxWcW9zhfpsvyYOC78AFw/4l6/QmEhIQD1RWqRLro-El8LcA/h2/h001.9JlxGjp5UrlXfmwl-yuGiVbOld2rpuQSeYTIno2VkEY). Welcome to the America that Lauren Boebert's sadism, cruelty, and racism, has spawned. Time is running out to change course. Our next opportunity is to fire Lauren Boebert next fall and it is truly now or never.

name: Letitia James
subject: I was arraigned on baseless charges
body:

Let me be clear: these charges are baseless. I am being targeted by Donald Trump and his allies for one simple reason – because I had the courage to hold him accountable for fraud, and for standing up to his destructive MAGA policies.
And while they think this will stop me, I refuse to back down.
They’re trying to silence me with this politically motivated indictment. I am fearless in this moment, but I need you to stand with me now to defend the truth and continue our fight for New York. Will you donate to my campaign so I can keep fighting as attorney general? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-james?refcode=103025_1]

name: Andy Kim
subject: Federal workers missed their second paycheck
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
Help provide groceries for federal workers and their families.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118297720/579298999/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzQ1ZmY4MC05YmI1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ojcVns5ZQzIYFj6SAE2jnDH-Z1ZEoLf7JtpYhx-ngaA=&emci=e12f0ce7-d4b4-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=8745ff80-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=26261389)
---

| | Since the government shut down on October 1, federal workers have either been off the job or working without pay. On October 24, they missed their second paycheck. Instead of negotiating an end to the shutdown, Donald Trump and his administration have threatened mass firings, even pledging to renege on a law _he signed_ to guarantee backpay to workers after a shutdown. **Trump sees a path to political victory through punishing the workers who keep Social Security working, who make sure our water is safe to drink, and who take care of our veterans.** The people who are working at Social Security offices, still making sure seniors’ checks go out on time, _won’t_ get their own check this week. Their bills didn’t stop. The rent is still due, and they still have families who need to eat. **We need solidarity, not charity.** [**Our friends at The Labor Force are distributing grocery cards to federal workers during this shutdown. In this episode of Freedom Frontline, we sit down with Congressman Mike Ezell, a devoted Christian, family man, and strong voice for Mississippi in Washington. From his decades of service in law enforcement to his fight in Congress, Congressman Ezell shares how faith has guided his decisions, how family keeps him grounded, and why freedom must always be defended.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3e3b0c4e-0e15-4030-9690-29d98f75fd1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We talk about what it means to lead with conviction, protect our communities, stand up for the unborn, and preserve the principles that built this nation. This is an inspiring, down-to-earth conversation about putting God first, family second, and fighting for the freedoms we all cherish. ---
| |

---
| |

#### **There are 3 ways to get in:**
* #### **Furloughed federal worker? You're my guest. Your ticket is waived. Please reply directly to this email so we can get you on the list.**

####
* #### **Bring a donation of canned goods.**

####
* #### **Buy a ticket!**

---
| |

| |

This is what solidarity looks like. We show up for each other.

|

| | Due to the inaction of the Republican House majority, **SNAP funding is about to lapse, leaving millions of vulnerable families hungry.** 42 million children and families are at risk of experiencing hunger without the safety net that SNAP provides. That is why I lead 213 Democrats in the House in our call to the USDA to use reserve dollars to fill the gap and fund SNAP while Republicans have shut down the government. Household groceries are hitting record highs, and many people who rely on SNAP benefits to keep food on the table and make ends meet will suffer. Without funding this program, many families will be forced to make tough decisions between utilities and groceries — a decision that could be deadly as we enter into the winter months. I am fighting day in and day out to urge this administration and the Republican majority to meet the needs of the American people and put people over party and over politics. **October 30: A personal note from Gabby Giffords to you.**

Please don’t click away from this message. Today is Thursday, October 30, and our final deadline before the fall elections is in less than 48 hours. Unfortunately, we are falling short of our fundraising goal, right as millions of Americans go to the polls.
If you are tired of the endless bad headlines about gun violence — and you are ready to do something about it — please join the 2% of supporters who are chipping in to end the gun violence epidemic in America.
When I founded GIFFORDS more than a decade ago, many warned me that the gun lobby was too difficult to take on. Now, gun safety is a winning issue...thanks to supporters like you.
GIFFORDS relies on the support of people like you to help us advance our cause in the courts and in state legislatures, and to get the message out widely when Republicans overstep.
**[So while you probably didn't wake up today and think you were going to make a donation to GIFFORDS, that's what I am asking you to do.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251030-1-b&t=2&akid=10999%2E3935704%2EH-YaHO)

subject: The NJEA is a disgrace
body:
Peter, First, this is your reminder that early in-person voting is underway now through November 2nd. Polls are open Monday-Saturday, 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m, and Sunday, 10:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. Your vote matters.

Peter, First, this is your reminder that **early in-person voting is underway****now****through November 2nd.**_Polls are open Monday-Saturday, 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m, and Sunday, 10:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m._ Your vote matters. Don’t be missing in action. The future of our state depends on the engagement of Common Sense New Jerseyans. Now, to the business of exposing more madness. I think we’ve all known for a while that the NJEA isn’t doing its job, is betraying its teachers, and is wasting their money on political agendas these teachers never agreed to support. (ICYMI – the NJEA is being [investigated](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/34639bd1795f468a243e5ca5d5713a06/eJyNkE1PwkAQhv_Lnrv2C4LpjRBCmiIHo2eztEMZLLOb3am1kv53BzWcNPE687zPfFwUAxnislGFeuePLMtVpDzU6BCIV5bY1F_dbD5L8zRSHdLrxtveqeLya_gGXMv3sySPFI8OBHl6XK6qcrd52Za7SkhnvMz4l2exyNKbZ_2wLLdqmv4Uwxl5_SbuoAr2PVwvalCu4mffCX9kdqGIY4LhBD7A6GyH9YgUGLlnuLO-jbMkm8dpEu_Bt0Ba0tY3mo-g6QQm6ENPDVKr7UEHMKSDw64Tm67N2RlsSQ9CDd4KM0gIoNGmrm0vL91jhzxq65DQUiwrG-eAmp9_VzB-Lz59AqIyjWA=) and [sued](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/7d2978599251f41bee89d9fdb5afbe3c/eJyNUE1PwzAM_S85N6TNWg31Nk3TVHXsgOCMQmtajzSJEndQpv53UkA7gYTkk9-H3_OFERhlqGpZyd7pQ8oVS5iHBh2Coa01pJovVBZ5tsoSptG87r0dHSsvv4qvhGV9m6dFwmhyECkP95ttXR33T4fqWEemUz7e-JfPei2zq8_ublMd2Dz_aQwD0u4cvQMryY-wNGoxtqJHryO_J3KhFMLA2wl8gMlZjc2EJhDSSHBjfSdkKguRpSI4Sxq7nrg5LUOgmj6qeBiB2zN4nqd8QK3RGt6owSnsDH-2NhB_sZ6PZgGch4BtjCRiPuUcmPbnuTVM3ynnT1GAhcs=) by NJ teachers for its lack of transparency and possible violations in its funneling of MILLIONS to the failed gubernatorial campaign of Sean Spiller...). One brave teacher, Marie Dupont, a plaintiff in the suit, is speaking out in [this](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/d5c3b63efb0d09e948f9783a0f6c91d4/eJyNkEFPwzAMhf9LzvW6tpuKepumaao6dkBwRlHiaGGrE6XuSpn630kB7QQS1-fnz-_5JhhJEtdaVOKdP_K8EIkIqKy3SLx1xFJ9TfP1KiuyRFwsnffB9V5Ut1-X74ZZflgty0Tw6DFanp8226Y-7l8P9bGJTi9DvPEvTlnm2Z2ze9zUBzFNf4Kxtby7RnYnKg49zo20ja34JVyi_8TsuypNh2FYDN3bQrk2dd6SdZRKYJTqhKGDfhZASdJWS0Zg587QjtA6whGiDEESGBfAGWMVQmFULvXSxAjSeyT9878Gx-8g0ye7ZXqr) powerful editorial in the Wall Street Journal.
---
| [ ](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/82158e9266ec56a6f9f901019ae9de38/eJyNkEFvwjAMhf9LzjWlLRNbbwghVBU4TNt5ihJHBKgTpS5dh_rfl24Tp03a9fn583u-CUaSxJUWpXjnjzwvRCICKustEq8dsVRf0_xhkRVZIi6WztvgOi_K26_Ld8MkPy7mT4ngwWO0vDyv1nV12L7tqkMdnV6GeONfnOUyz-6czX5V7cQ4_gnGxvLmGtmtKDl0ODXSNrbi13CJ_iOzb8s07ft-1renmXJN6rwl6yiVwCjVEUML3SSAkqStlozAzp2hGaBxhANEGYIkMC6AM8YqhMKoXOq5iRGk90j65381Dt9Bxk-9f3qt)
---
I would be remiss not to point out that the NJEA is a MAJOR donor to the Mikie Sherrill campaign through indirect means (of course). They appear to have dumped over $40 million into independent expenditures favoring her, in addition to endorsing her. Well, the Daily Wire just reported that – while reading and math scores stagnate – the NJEA is [focusing](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/6ad3b8a537f179c1ae77ed56df57ee04/eJyNUL1OwzAQfhfPvUZJi4qyVVVVRSkdEMzosI_EJLEt-1oTqr47DiBYQOp63_-dBZNBw5USpXjj96JYiJnwJLXTZHhjDaP8RIubZb7IZ6LXptt5e3SiPP8p_iFM59tlnjQ8OkqUh_v1pq4Ou6d9dagT06FPGVf5rFbFr8_2bl3txeXyrzENmren5B1Eyf5I0yKl0yp-9H3it8wulFkWY5wr1P0YEziXdsgMxZCxdWBewdles5bYA_oBnlF22jSgaIDGnkCiUVohE7Q2cIBoOwLlsQGakuHFemBC2ZIPqRI6R0Z9_7Om8avY5QPJ2YGd) on supporting teachers where it _really_ matters: celebrating the “vibrant world of drag” because “drag is what education is all about.” Are you kidding me? And they wonder why parents are pulling their kids out, standing up in school board meetings, and calling for education freedom. Because they think THIS is their role. To indoctrinate teachers to then indoctrinate young and impressionable students with woke, radical, extremist, and sexualized content. ENOUGH! We need more bold New Jerseyans to stand up – like these brave teachers challenging the NJEA or the moms who stood up to a school librarian pushing sexual content on minors. And we need to be paying attention to the political figures who take their donations and their adulation. Because that tells us all we need to know about the direction they’ll take us and our kids. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

---
President
Common Sense Club
---

You are the Hope of America!

We’re thrilled to invite you to join Kimberly Fletcher, Founder and President of Moms for America®, for a brand-new 4-week webinar
series:

HANDS OF HEAVEN: HEALING AMERICA FROM THE INSIDE OUT

In this inspiring series, Kimberly shares stories, principles, and real-life examples that reveal how mothers have always been
God’s way of bringing healing and change to the world. You’ll discover:

* The powerful influence mothers have on the heart of a nation

* The true epic story of America and our divine heritage of liberty

* How today’s culture is reshaping our children—and what we can do about it

* How to raise patriots who will carry the torch of freedom forward

Each 60-minute session will uplift, educate, and empower you to make a difference right where you are—at your kitchen table, in
your community, and in your country.

DATES & DETAILS

* When: Every Monday in November, beginning November 4th

* Time: 5 p.m. Pacific, 6 p.m. Mountain, 7 p.m. Central, 8 p.m. Eastern

* Where: Online via live Zoom webinar—link provided upon registration.

THIS IS A ONE-TIME-ONLY EVENT

This special series will not be available on our website or in the MFA library.
The only way to experience Hands of Heaven is to register for the series before it ends.

Don’t miss your opportunity to be part of this exclusive gathering of mothers standing together to heal America from the inside

clean_body: Join hands with Kimberly Fletcher as she discusses our American history and heritage as we work to preserve freedom for ourselves and our children. If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] You are the Hope of America! We’re thrilled to invite you to join Kimberly Fletcher, Founder and President of Moms for America®, for a brand-new 4-week webinar series: HANDS OF HEAVEN: HEALING AMERICA FROM THE INSIDE OUT In this inspiring series, Kimberly shares stories, principles, and real-life examples that reveal how mothers have always been God’s way of bringing healing and change to the world. You’ll discover: The powerful influence mothers have on the heart of a nation The true epic story of America and our divine heritage of liberty How today’s culture is reshaping our children—and what we can do about it How to raise patriots who will carry the torch of freedom forward Each 60-minute session will uplift, educate, and empower you to make a difference right where you are—at your kitchen table, in your community, and in your country. DATES & DETAILS When: Every Monday in November, beginning November 4th Time: 5 p.m. Pacific, 6 p.m. Mountain, 7 p.m. Central, 8 p.m. Eastern * Where: Online via live Zoom webinar—link provided upon registration. THIS IS A ONE-TIME-ONLY EVENT This special series will not be available on our website or in the MFA library. The only way to experience Hands of Heaven is to register for the series before it ends. Don’t miss your opportunity to be part of this exclusive gathering of mothers standing together to heal America from the inside out. Reserve your spot today! [] Whether you join from home or with friends, Hands of Heaven will remind you that your hands—the hands that serve, teach, and nurture—are the very hands God uses to heal nations. REGISTER [] LIKE WHAT WE DO? Your tax-deductible gift to Moms for America® will help support us in our mission to Empower Moms, Promote Liberty, and Raise Patriots! name: Jennifer Anju Grossman
subject: A new kind of terror
body:
What is causing these young people to become monsters?

|
---
| | [](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyMkLGO6yAQRb8Gd7aGwQa_guJJkbtsu6VFYDZBi8GCSaz8_SqRtt_66F4dnc_zenYxxXz9cBtZn461ttVlOr5jDuWLqdZSVwScegm9ghfGLthpRvqnO7LSaDmPAAa6mw1SzjPghEZNFz_ChTyMY6BZGvLKhC7a15UEBVIDKDNoo9AEBDlNoKWcxQguUeXBl9yoPhzHB6V4ocrPI1YafNm6ZG_MexPqv8BF4NLI3ysNLlMor-UmcOEb9Y6Ta30rPhI_BS67653nWLJQy5231bttd_GahTr9agnUb1IyU2ahTj4dXbVhP2JKsWkjRrhuLqa3CP-52MPiTwAAAP__NCl00g) Friend,

The rise in political violence is frightening enough, but once I realized the truth behind the terror, it chilled me to the very core of my being.

These terrorists aren't who you'd expect. They are young people who come from ordinary, middle-class families, living in functional homes with loving parents.

_**What is causing these young people to become monsters?**_

A growing nihilistic online culture -- that believes life is meaningless, truth is subjective, and nothing ultimately matters -- seeks to tear down and destroy all that is good in our society.

This destructive philosophy is seeping into American households through memes, message boards, comment sections, and peer-to-peer apps - undetected by parents, law enforcement, and society at large.

_**How can you and I reverse this worrisome trend? **_

In her address to the graduating class of West Point, Ayn Rand gave us a clue:

"Observe young people's dread of independence...When men abandon reason, they find not only that their emotions cannot guide them, but that they can experience no emotions save one: terror."

Like cornered animals, they turn and seek to inflict terror on others.

The remedy is simple: A return to REASON. By introducing the rising generation to the ideas of Ayn Rand, we can counter the terrifying nihilism gripping young people today.

I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society. Our mission is to inspire people to embrace reason, achievement, benevolence, and rational self-interest as the moral foundation for political liberty, personal happiness, and a flourishing society.

**Through our viral videos, podcasts, graphic novels, online courses, and live events, we reach the next generation where they get their information and give them the tools to reject the brutality, despair, and irrationalism they absorb online.**

[You can help us end the chaos and misery that is gripping our young people and our society by donating today.](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyMkLGO6yAQRb8Gd7aGwQa_guJJkbtsu6VFYDZBi8GCSaz8_SqRtt_66F4dnc_zenYxxXz9cBtZn461ttVlOr5jDuWLqdZSVwScegm9ghfGLthpRvqnO7LSaDmPAAa6mw1SzjPghEZNFz_ChTyMY6BZGvLKhC7a15UEBVIDKDNoo9AEBDlNoKWcxQguUeXBl9yoPhzHB6V4ocrPI1YafNm6ZG_MexPqv8BF4NLI3ysNLlMor-UmcOEb9Y6Ta30rPhI_BS67653nWLJQy5231bttd_GahTr9agnUb1IyU2ahTj4dXbVhP2JKsWkjRrhuLqa3CP-52MPiTwAAAP__NCl00g)

Online nihilism isn't just a fringe meme; it's a cultural force.

It disarms individuals, weakens societies, and undermines the very foundations that allow civilizations to thrive.

This nihilism doesn't just reflect despair; it shapes behavior, attitudes, and even politics in deeply consequential ways.

And we've all seen the terrible consequences played out before our very eyes... The assassination of Charlie Kirk is just one tragic example.

Young people are desperate for meaning, purpose, and acceptance. And if they fail to find meaning, they reject everything and fill that void with radical ideologies.

**They need heroes who inspire them to achieve greatness and a philosophy that guides them to embrace reason, facts, and debate - rather than violence.**

That's why The Atlas Society leverages content that young audiences gravitate towards, such as our action-packed animated book trailers, provocative "Draw My Life" videos, and captivating graphic novels.

**By introducing the next generation to the empowering principles of Objectivism, we provide a rational and moral alternative to the violent culture of nihilism. We provide hope.**

But we can't do it without your help.

[As long as this trend continues, none of us is safe! clean_body: What is causing these young people to become monsters? | | | Friend, The rise in political violence is frightening enough, but once I realized the truth behind the terror, it chilled me to the very core of my being. These terrorists aren't who you'd expect. They are young people who come from ordinary, middle-class families, living in functional homes with loving parents. What is causing these young people to become monsters? A growing nihilistic online culture -- that believes life is meaningless, truth is subjective, and nothing ultimately matters -- seeks to tear down and destroy all that is good in our society. This destructive philosophy is seeping into American households through memes, message boards, comment sections, and peer-to-peer apps - undetected by parents, law enforcement, and society at large. How can you and I reverse this worrisome trend? In her address to the graduating class of West Point, Ayn Rand gave us a clue: "Observe young people's dread of independence...When men abandon reason, they find not only that their emotions cannot guide them, but that they can experience no emotions save one: terror." Like cornered animals, they turn and seek to inflict terror on others. The remedy is simple: A return to REASON. By introducing the rising generation to the ideas of Ayn Rand, we can counter the terrifying nihilism gripping young people today. I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society. Our mission is to inspire people to embrace reason, achievement, benevolence, and rational self-interest as the moral foundation for political liberty, personal happiness, and a flourishing society. Through our viral videos, podcasts, graphic novels, online courses, and live events, we reach the next generation where they get their information and give them the tools to reject the brutality, despair, and irrationalism they absorb online. Online nihilism isn't just a fringe meme; it's a cultural force. It disarms individuals, weakens societies, and undermines the very foundations that allow civilizations to thrive. This nihilism doesn't just reflect despair; it shapes behavior, attitudes, and even politics in deeply consequential ways. And we've all seen the terrible consequences played out before our very eyes... The assassination of Charlie Kirk is just one tragic example. Young people are desperate for meaning, purpose, and acceptance. And if they fail to find meaning, they reject everything and fill that void with radical ideologies. They need heroes who inspire them to achieve greatness and a philosophy that guides them to embrace reason, facts, and debate - rather than violence. That's why The Atlas Society leverages content that young audiences gravitate towards, such as our action-packed animated book trailers, provocative "Draw My Life" videos, and captivating graphic novels. By introducing the next generation to the empowering principles of Objectivism, we provide a rational and moral alternative to the violent culture of nihilism. We provide hope. But we can't do it without your help. Thank you for helping us fight back. Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG) CEO, The Atlas Society P.S. The battle for the future isn 't just political -- it's philosophical. And right now, it's being waged in the minds of young people online. _I served in uniform because America is worth protecting. _

name: Tom Fitton
subject: More “voters” than citizens – we’re suing to clean voter rolls
body:
Your Judicial Watch is leading the charge to clean up a rampant threat to fair and honest elections:

| [ | |
---
|
--- ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77472&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) |
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Your Judicial Watch is leading the charge to clean up a rampant threat to fair and honest elections:

_Dirty voter rolls_.

**Consider Oregon, where 35 of its 36 counties (and the state as a whole) report more registered voters than actual living, eligible voting-age residents**.

The rolls are bloated with the names of the deceased and those who have moved away.

_It 's illegal_. The National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) requires "a general program that makes a reasonable effort to remove" from voter rolls "the names of ineligible voters." And 29 of the 36 Oregon counties have removed almost zero ineligible names.

So we've taken legal action and sued the State of Oregon under provisions of the National Voter Registration Act (_Judicial Watch, et al. v. The State of Oregon et al._).

**And just recently, a federal court ruled that our lawsuit can proceed.**
| [ Please give a generous gift right now to help us sue states like Oregon to force them to clean up their voter rolls ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77472&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

We know litigation like this works:

* In Ohio, we secured a landmark settlement in 2014 requiring the state to adopt rigorous list-maintenance under the NVRA.
* Our Pennsylvania lawsuit led to the removal of over 178,258 ineligible registrations in 2023 and a legal settlement enforcing compliance for five years.
* We forced New York City to pare 918,139 outdated registrations from its records since our 2022 legal action against them.
* And in Los Angeles County, legal pressure from Judicial Watch forced the removal of 1.2 million ineligible voters from the rolls.

_Across the country,__Judicial Watch 's combined litigation and investigations have driven the removal of over 5 million outdated registrations from voter rolls in these and several other states_.

Why does this matter?

**Because dirty voter rolls can mean dirty elections.**

Judicial Watch has built the strongest conservative election-law team in the country. **. And we rely on the gifts of our supporters like you to fuel these efforts.**. Not just in Oregon, but wherever else the law is being broken.

We WILL be suing more states with dirty voter rolls...funds permitting. Please consider making a generous first-time contribution to support this work and all our work fighting government corruption.

[ Make a Gift Today to Fund Judicial Watch’s Election Integrity Work ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77472&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Thank you for supporting our work, and considering a gift to help us clean up voter rolls and preserve honest elections.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton

President, Judicial Watch
P.S. Oregon is just one of several states where Judicial Watch has active voter roll cleanup litigation, including California and Illinois. And my team is preparing legal actions in other states as we speak. _[Please make a gift now to support this critical work.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77472&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.

You've probably seen the headlines that SNAP - our nation's largest food assistance program, on which 1 in 4 children rely - may be about to come to a screeching halt.
The situation is very serious.
Here's a quick **[video](https://substack.com/redirect/d3ede0d3-cc29-4aa3-9945-db05d67042cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** explainer on YouTube, with more detail below:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3a4897-b3e6-4884-952c-6af309cdd4af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Here 's the situation:**
Last week, the Agriculture Department sent a letter to all 50 states saying funding for SNAP would end on November 1.
They claimed they had no choice, that they'd run out of money because of the shutdown.
That is false.
The truth is, they have a _$6 billion emergency fund_ that Congress gave them to make sure SNAP isn't interrupted.
The Department is claiming they can't use their emergency fund for this, but we know that is false for three reasons:
1. In creating the emergency fund, Congress was very clear: the fund is for use "in such amounts and at such times as may become necessary to carry out program operations."
2. During the last shutdown, in January 2019, the Department said they could use the emergency fund for SNAP, stating that "limited funding is available from the contingency [fund] that can be used to provide benefits for February. This reserve is being used to fund recertifications and new applications through February."

3. About a month ago, the Department published a plan for how they'd deal with a government shutdown, and explicitly said they could tap the emergency fund if needed.
Read their words for yourself:

> Congressional intent is evident that **SNAP 's operations should continue since the program has been provided with multi-year contingency funds that can be used** for State Administrative Expenses to ensure that the State can also continue operations **during a Federal Government shutdown.** These multi-year **contingency funds are also available to fund participant benefits in the event that a lapse occurs in the middle of the fiscal year.**
Now -_with less than one week 's notice - _the Department reversed itself and decided to let the $6 billion emergency fund sit on the shelf.
Why?
To ratchet up the pain of the shutdown. They are making a painful situation worse to help others make a political argument. And they're hoping that most people never learn this was a choice - that they have the money and are refusing to use it.

Yes, the government is in a shutdown - and yes, the emergency fund would eventually run out if this continues.
But **right now** , they have billions in emergency reserves **sitting untouched** , and that's the reason SNAP payments are about to stop.
As for the impact, we don't really have a precedent. SNAP has never been shut off before. It's kind of like breaching the debt ceiling - it would definitely be a disaster, but because it's never happened there's always a chorus of folks saying, "Eh, no big deal."
But this would be a very big deal.
Let's focus on what it would mean for kids.
1 in 4 children in our country rely on SNAP.
That's 16 million kids nationwide - and 600,000 in NC.
1.7 million babies rely on it - and 40,000 in NC.
The average benefit payment in NC? About $180 a month.
And despite some comments I've seen, undocumented immigrants aren't eligible and there are strict work requirements for folks without kids or disabilities.
If SNAP stops, we'll all watch as food pantries are overwhelmed. Childhood hunger will spike. This will hit schools like a ton of bricks. Teachers will face classrooms full of kids who haven't eaten enough. And by the time we reach Thanksgiving, this will be a full-blown crisis.
**So here 's what we're doing about it:**
When the Agriculture Department chose to ignore its emergency fund, it broke the law. Congress gave them that money to fund the program - departments can't just refuse to use it. Doing so is the same as overriding Congress, and departments can't do that.
So I've joined with other attorneys general, and we're taking the Department to court.
Because this is urgent - _we have two days_ \- we've asked the court for an emergency order requiring the Department to continue funding SNAP while the case proceeds.
Our hearing is **today.**
The next time you hear from me, I'll let you know the result.
One last note:
I have extraordinary people at the NC Department of Justice working around the clock on this case. I told them that an awesome responsibility rests on our shoulders - and that we're up to it.
More soon,
Jeff Jackson

ELECTION TIME:
Head to the polls to weigh in on Texas statewide propositions
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Go%20Vote%20-%20TOP%20Teal%20design.jpg]
We’re now in the second week of early voting for our state's constitutional amendments election. A number of local races and special elections are also taking place across the state, so don't miss your chance to have your voice heard at the polls.
Voters in our state will weigh in on 17 statewide propositions this election. If approved by the majority of voters, these ballot propositions become constitutional amendments, which are then enshrined in our state constitution.
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1BMe2tcAyV/ [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1BMe2tcAyV/]
Early voting ends Friday, Oct. 31. Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 4.
Visit GoVoteTexas.org for more voting info and to find polling places. [https://govotetexas.org/]
Condemning Trump's refusal to fund SNAP
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Trump%20and%20SNAP%20benefits%20-%20combined.jpg]
Forty-two million people in the U.S. are about to lose access to food assistance because of Trump’s government shutdown, and what’s he doing? Dancing to ‘YMCA’ and planning his White House ballroom.
It’s unconscionable. This billionaire president is completely detached from the people he’s supposed to serve. What’s even more infuriating, is that the Trump administration is sitting on $5 billion in emergency SNAP funds that could prevent families from going hungry. But Trump’s refusing to use it.
In Texas alone, 3.5 million people — including 1.7 million children — rely on SNAP each month. We’re facing a state and national emergency that goes beyond politics. Black and Latino working families across Texas are fighting to put food on the table. Every person who calls this country home — regardless of age, race, background, or income level — deserves basic food security.
https://www.texastribune.org/2025/10/28/texas-snap-food-stamps-lone-star-card-how-to-help/ [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/10/28/texas-snap-food-stamps-lone-star-card-how-to-help/]
THIS SATURDAY:
Honor Día De Los Muertos with TOP in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dia%20De%20Los%20Muertos%20-%20Dancers.jpg]
YOU'RE INVITED: Join Houston TOP staff and members on Saturday, Nov. 1, from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. as we celebrate Dia De Los Muertos with community allies at MECA.
Come enjoy the food, festivities, and fellowship.
We hope to see you there! For more event information and to RSVP, email Andres at arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: 🎉 Chip in $15 as we celebrate our first 15 years 🎉
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2025%20Galveston%20mural.jpg]
For the past 15 years, TOP has built people power and political power alongside Black and Latino Texans to win policies that aim to lift up ALL in our state. To memorialize this milestone, TOP staff and members gathered in Galveston this past weekend and to reflect, celebrate, and team-build (stay tuned for more on this soon! 😎)
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top15em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/top15em]
Español
TIEMPO DE ELECCIONES:
Acuda a las urnas para expresar su opinión sobre las propuestas estatales de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Go%20Vote%20-%20TOP%20Teal%20design.jpg]
Ya estamos en la segunda semana de votación anticipada para las enmiendas constitucionales de nuestro estado. También se están llevando a cabo varias elecciones locales y especiales en todo el estado, así que no pierda la oportunidad de hacer oír su voz en las urnas.
Los votantes de nuestro estado se pronunciarán sobre 17 propuestas estatales en estas elecciones. Si la mayoría de los votantes las aprueba, estas propuestas se convertirán en enmiendas constitucionales, que luego se incorporarán a la constitución estatal.
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1BMe2tcAyV/ [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1BMe2tcAyV/]
La votación anticipada termina el viernes 31 de octubre. El día de las elecciones es el martes 4 de noviembre.
Visite GoVoteTexas.org para obtener más información sobre la votación y encontrar los centros de votación. [https://govotetexas.org/]
Condenando la negativa de Trump a financiar el programa SNAP
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Trump%20and%20SNAP%20benefits%20-%20combined.jpg]
Cuarenta y dos millones de personas en Estados Unidos están a punto de perder el acceso a la asistencia alimentaria debido al cierre del gobierno de Trump, ¿y qué hace él? Bailando al ritmo de "YMCA" y planeando su salón de baile en la Casa Blanca.
Es inconcebible. Este presidente multimillonario está completamente desconectado de la gente a la que se supone que debe servir. Lo que es aún más indignante es que el gobierno de Trump tiene retenidos 5 mil millones de dólares en fondos de emergencia del SNAP que podrían evitar que las familias pasen hambre. Pero Trump se niega a usarlos.
Tan solo en Texas, 3.5 millones de personas, incluyendo 1.7 millones de niños, dependen del SNAP cada mes. Nos enfrentamos a una emergencia estatal y nacional que va más allá de la política. Familias trabajadoras morenas y latinas en todo Texas luchan por tener comida en la mesa. Toda persona que vive en este país, sin importar su edad, raza, origen o nivel de ingresos, merece seguridad alimentaria básica.
https://www.texastribune.org/2025/10/28/texas-snap-food-stamps-lone-star-card-how-to-help/ [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/10/28/texas-snap-food-stamps-lone-star-card-how-to-help/]
ESTE SÁBADO:
Celebra el Día de los Muertos con TOP en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dia%20De%20Los%20Muertos%20-%20Dancers.jpg]
ESTÁS INVITADO/A: Únete al personal y a los miembros de Houston TOP el sábado 1 de noviembre, de 11:00 a 7:00 pm, para celebrar el Día de los Muertos con aliados de la comunidad en MECA.
Ven a disfrutar de la comida, las festividades y la convivencia. ¡Te esperamos!
Para más información sobre el evento y para confirmar tu asistencia, escribe a Andrés a arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: 🎉 Dona $15 para celebrar nuestros primeros 15 años 🎉
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2025%20Galveston%20mural.jpg]
Durante los últimos 15 años, TOP ha impulsado el poder popular y político junto a los tejanos morenos y latinos para lograr políticas que buscan beneficiar a TODOS en nuestro estado. Para conmemorar este hito, el personal y los miembros de TOP se reunieron en Galveston el fin de semana pasado para reflexionar, celebrar y fortalecer el equipo (¡pronto les contaremos más! 😎)

[] THIS SATURDAY: Honor Día De Los Muertos with TOP in Houston [] YOU'RE INVITED: Join Houston TOP staff and members on Saturday, Nov. 1, from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. as we celebrate Dia De Los Muertos with community allies at MECA. Come enjoy the food, festivities, and fellowship. We hope to see you there! For more event information and to RSVP, email Andres at arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] . TOP Tip: 🎉 Chip in $15 as we celebrate our first 15 years 🎉 [] For the past 15 years, TOP has built people power and political power alongside Black and Latino Texans to win policies that aim to lift up ALL in our state. To memorialize this milestone, TOP staff and members gathered in Galveston this past weekend and to reflect, celebrate, and team-build (stay tuned for more on this soon! 😎) [] Español TIEMPO DE ELECCIONES: Acuda a las urnas para expresar su opinión sobre las propuestas estatales de Texas [] Ya estamos en la segunda semana de votación anticipada para las enmiendas constitucionales de nuestro estado. También se están llevando a cabo varias elecciones locales y especiales en todo el estado, así que no pierda la oportunidad de hacer oír su voz en las urnas. Los votantes de nuestro estado se pronunciarán sobre 17 propuestas estatales en estas elecciones. Si la mayoría de los votantes las aprueba, estas propuestas se convertirán en enmiendas constitucionales, que luego se incorporarán a la constitución estatal. [] La votación anticipada termina el viernes 31 de octubre. El día de las elecciones es el martes 4 de noviembre. Visite GoVoteTexas.org para obtener más información sobre la votación y encontrar los centros de votación. [] Condenando la negativa de Trump a financiar el programa SNAP [] Cuarenta y dos millones de personas en Estados Unidos están a punto de perder el acceso a la asistencia alimentaria debido al cierre del gobierno de Trump, ¿y qué hace él? Bailando al ritmo de "YMCA" y planeando su salón de baile en la Casa Blanca. Es inconcebible. Este presidente multimillonario está completamente desconectado de la gente a la que se supone que debe servir. Lo que es aún más indignante es que el gobierno de Trump tiene retenidos 5 mil millones de dólares en fondos de emergencia del SNAP que podrían evitar que las familias pasen hambre. Pero Trump se niega a usarlos. Tan solo en Texas, 3.5 millones de personas, incluyendo 1.7 millones de niños, dependen del SNAP cada mes. Nos enfrentamos a una emergencia estatal y nacional que va más allá de la política. Familias trabajadoras morenas y latinas en todo Texas luchan por tener comida en la mesa. Toda persona que vive en este país, sin importar su edad, raza, origen o nivel de ingresos, merece seguridad alimentaria básica. [] ESTE SÁBADO: Celebra el Día de los Muertos con TOP en Houston [] ESTÁS INVITADO/A: Únete al personal y a los miembros de Houston TOP el sábado 1 de noviembre, de 11:00 a 7:00 pm, para celebrar el Día de los Muertos con aliados de la comunidad en MECA. Ven a disfrutar de la comida, las festividades y la convivencia. ¡Te esperamos! Para más información sobre el evento y para confirmar tu asistencia, escribe a Andrés a arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] . Consejos de TOP: 🎉 Dona $15 para celebrar nuestros primeros 15 años 🎉 [] Durante los últimos 15 años, TOP ha impulsado el poder popular y político junto a los tejanos morenos y latinos para lograr políticas que buscan beneficiar a TODOS en nuestro estado. Para conmemorar este hito, el personal y los miembros de TOP se reunieron en Galveston el fin de semana pasado para reflexionar, celebrar y fortalecer el equipo (¡pronto les contaremos más! 😎) [] Copyright (C) 2025 Texas Organizing Project. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Face-to-face with the people powering our movement
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

I’m back on the road across Texas where we just had an energizing event in
Tarrant County, one of those counties that we flipped in 2018 but that
went for Trump last November. It just goes to show that nothing about
winning power in Texas is easy, that no victory is final, and that the
work is never over. It seems like the hundreds of people who came out last
night in Fort Worth understand that. More than 80 of them signed up for
block walk shifts and more than a dozen told us they’re open to running
for places on the ballot in Tarrant County in 2026.

Being with all of these great people who came out more than a year from
the biggest midterm of our lives filled me with hope and confidence. Plus,
it was fun to reconnect with those I’ve volunteered with before, to listen
to great speakers and candidates, and to enjoy a cold beer on a cold (for
Fort Worth) Texas night.

Persistence, hard work, and the power (and joy) of people is how we’re
going to get it done.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251030.zNRruc&refcode=ema20251030-240435&t=1002&akid=240435%2E444211%2E5G_QNJ ]Event in Fort Worth

What makes Powered by People different is our personal focus on the voters
who will decide the outcome of the elections ahead of us. We meet them,
listen to them, and work together with them whether they’re in small rural
towns, in suburban counties, or big cities. And in doing this work, we’ve
built an extraordinary community of passionate volunteers that grows by
the day, everyone focused on winning political power by literally meeting
people where they’re at.

We’re not backed by corporate interests or the DNC or establishment
interests. We’re powered by people like you—folks who believe in fairness,
opportunity, and making sure everyone has a voice and a chance to build a
better life.

But it takes resources to make all of that happen... to keep the movement
moving, to keep the road open, and to keep showing up for people across
this country—in red and blue communities alike.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251030.zNRruc&refcode=ema20251030-240435&t=1003&akid=240435%2E444211%2E5G_QNJ ]Will you chip in today to Powered by People? Your support keeps us
traveling, meeting people where they are, and building a movement that’s
truly powered by the people. Because together, there’s nothing we can’t
do.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20251030.zNRruc&refcode=ema20251030-240435&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=240435%2E444211%2E5G_QNJ ]DONATE $3

Beto O’Rourke

#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/97246?refcode=em20251030-9654&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9654%2E614464%2E4vRQ2C)
Peter —
I know you get a lot of emails from me. But I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for governor, and why your support is so critical to our success.
**I was raised to believe that we have an obligation to our community and our country.** This country gave my family so much, and it’s always been obvious to me that I wanted to dedicate my life to public service.
It’s why I took my first oath to the Constitution as a teenager when I entered the Naval Academy.
It’s why I spent nearly a decade in the Navy as a helicopter pilot and Russian policy officer.
It’s why I went to law school, and became an Outreach and Reentry Coordinator and a federal prosecutor.
**Peter, it’s why I first decided to run for office.**
In 2017, I watched Donald Trump attack every value that I had spent my life fighting for. And as I thought about it, I realized I couldn’t ask someone to do my fighting for me – that if I wanted to defend the country I love then I had to run toward the crisis.
It was a long shot to run as a nobody in a district that had been held by an entrenched Republican for more than two decades.
**But I knew what was at stake and I knew what I had to do.**
I’m proud of the work I’ve done in Congress — work that earned me the distinction of being named the most effective member of the New Jersey House delegation in just my second term.
**But I know I can do more as your governor. And that’s why I decided to run.**
By winning this seat, we reduce mortgage and rental costs, crack down on shady middlemen making prescription medications more expensive, and bring down utility costs by bringing more clean, cheap power like solar onto the grid.
But the truth is that this is already the most expensive New Jersey gubernatorial race on record. And my opponent is benefiting not only from Donald Trump's personal endorsement — but from the support of Trump's entire network of deep-pocketed, right-wing allies. So I am asking:
**[Will you consider splitting $5 or whatever you can between NJ Victory 25 and State Democrats Committee to help power us to victory?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/97246?refcode=em20251030-9654&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9654%2E614464%2E4vRQ2C)**

clean_body: | = Team — Attorney General Pam Bondi appeared at her first oversight hearing after nine months of her stewardship of the Justice Department. It was urgent — after all, hundreds of career prosecutors have quit because of the politicization of the Justice Department and the fear that they might have to take unethical actions at the direction of Trump and Bondi. We’ve seen the DOJ cover up the corruption of the administration and its friends — like the WH Border Czar taking $50,000 in cash from undercover FBI agents. Or the corruption case against the Mayor of NYC. Or the Epstein files. And we’ve seen the department prosecute the president’s enemies at the president’s urging — like James Comey — even though career prosecutors said the case lacked evidence. Team, it’s safe to say Pam Bondi was not too pleased with my line of questioning. Don’t just take it from me, look at some of the headlines from the hearing: = Team, the Department of Justice has become Trump’s personal sword to go after his ever-growing list of political enemies, including me. And his shield to cover up corruption and hide wrongdoing. And Pam Bondi has enabled this behavior. Instead of going after Tom Homan, Trump’s border czar, for taking the 50 thousand in cash, the DOJ shut down the investigation. When I asked Attorney General Bondi about this, she deflected responsibility. Said she didn’t know or wouldn’t comment about the case. She said that I should be fired. Team, she even said I should apologize to Donald Trump for leading his first impeachment trial. Not gonna happen. The Department of Justice should be pursuing accountability, cracking down on corruption, and defending the Constitution. But under this administration, the DOJ is a tool for attacking enemies and covering up wrongdoing. I will continue to use my position on the Judiciary Committee to conduct hard oversight and demand concrete answers. I will call out corruption and speak out against any and every attempt to weaponize our legal system against Trump’s political opponents. I will not give in, and not back down. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Adam Schiff and Off the Sidelines PAC will go through immediately: | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Adam © 2025 | Paid for by Off the Sidelines PAC

We’re strategizing, and we’re fighting back. | | | Peter, In just two days, millions of working families will feel the disastrous consequences of Trump’s healthcare cuts and the government shutdown. With insurance premiums on the Affordable Care Act marketplace skyrocketing and the halting of SNAP benefits, far too many of our friends and neighbors will find themselves needing to choose between life-saving medical care and food. Republicans control the House, the Senate, and the White House. **They can end this at any time by passing a funding bill that lowers healthcare costs and brings federal employees back to work.** But we refuse to sit around and wait for the day they develop some compassion for their own constituents.
