* * *
The Trump administration ramped up its attacks on Chicago this week by indicting several prominent Illinois Democrats and elected officials for _peacefully_ protesting ICE. Their reasoning? These individuals somehow "broke the law" by standing in front of an ICE vehicle that tried to barrel through them during a protest.
It's yet another grotesque abuse of power from Donald Trump--a fascist who has never hesitated to use the federal government as a weapon against his political enemies. And sure, I could turn this into another rant about lawfare and authoritarian overreach. Those things are real. This is no different than when he went after James Comey, Tish James, Adam Schiff, or literally anyone who dares to challenge him.
But I think this is something even darker. This is about scaring the people of Chicago into silence. About making an example out of those brave enough to stand up. So let's say it out loud--because it _needs_ to be said every time: masked federal agents are snatching people off the street based on the color of their skin and throwing them into unmarked vehicles.
That's the level of chaos we're dealing with. Just last week--while I was out of town--ICE tear-gassed peaceful protesters _a block and a half_ from my house. People trying to stop an abduction. In my neighborhood.
They want a show of force. They want to go after elected officials and community leaders to make regular people think, _" If they'll do that to someone like them, what will they do to me?"_ They want to create just enough fear that people second-guess showing up, second-guess organizing, second-guess protecting their neighbors.
But let me tell you something: Chicago doesn't bow to tyrants. We don't suffer fools or bullies. I've never been prouder of this city I now call home--the city I plan to grow old in. Trump, Tom Homan, Kristi Noem, and their ICE operatives have been trying to provoke violence here. Trying to justify invoking the Insurrection Act, trying to turn this city into a militarized zone like it's some war game.
But Chicago won't bite.
* * *
_**[Endless Urgency is free to read, but we're hustling to launch our new content studio and pay our new Community Manager a living wage. Paid subscribers make it all possible--just $8/month if you're down to support](https://substack.com/redirect/ecf79d80-d958-4854-bd0f-34555d22933a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/ecf79d80-d958-4854-bd0f-34555d22933a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
Instead, the people here have responded with empathy, with heart, and with fierce, unwavering love for one another. We've organized. We've protected each other. We've protested _peacefully._ You have people who've never been political in their lives out here guarding schools, handing out know-your-rights kits, blowing whistles when something goes wrong. People are sharing information. Showing up. Doing the work--every damn day.
I'm proud to be one of them. Right here in my neighborhood. Doing what I can to organize, to connect, to build community. And in that process, I've met so many incredible neighbors--folks I used to just nod at while walking my dog or pushing a stroller. Now I know they've got my back. And I've got theirs. We're standing together, putting our bodies on the line, refusing to accept this dystopia as normal or okay.
Because it's not.
I've written about this before, and I'll keep writing it: we're watching the ugliest parts of humanity play out in real time. The Trump administration is targeting people not because they lack documentation, but because of the color of their skin..
And it's disgusting.
But even in that darkness, we're also seeing the best of humanity. People coordinating school pickups so undocumented parents aren't abducted outside the building. People organizing food drives for neighbors too scared to leave home. People doing what they can, in their own corner of the world, to keep each other safe. That's the beauty of this city. That's the power of the American spirit. And I know it's not just happening in Chicago--it's happening everywhere.
When I get low--when I'm burned out, overwhelmed by the chaos, by ICE, by Trump, by all of it--I think about the quiet, persistent acts of resistance happening all around me.
I talk about this on the show: a rural hospital closing in Butler, Nebraska. Trump carried that area by probably 70%. And still, when that hospital shut down, people showed up for each other. Even if they don't share my politics, they share my values: community, compassion, care. That thread runs through more people in this country than you'd think.
Right now, we're facing some heavy shit. A federal government that's not just corrupt, but predatory. A shutdown dragging on God-knows-how-many days. SNAP benefits are about to vanish for 40 million people. A president who refuses to acknowledge reality--whether it's the job market, his disastrous tariffs, or the basic fact that he is not a king.
But I believe in the people. I believe in the power we have to care for one another. And that's the spirit we have to hold on to.
I write these rants, in part, to remind _myself_ of that. To reconnect with what matters. But also to remind _you_ that you have power. You _can_ do something meaningful. Maybe it's organizing a protest. Maybe it's packing food boxes. Maybe it's just being a good parent, or taking a damn nap so you can show up again tomorrow.
Whatever it is--find it. Do it. Keep showing up. I see you, and I appreciate the hell out of you.

name: Tim Holbert, American Veterans Center
subject: Celebrate 250 years of American valor with your free American flag
body:
For more than two decades, American Veterans Center has been dedicated to honoring the sacrifice and preserving the legacy of our nation’s heroes.

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zqm1p80093tptsa4b0djuggai5valjkl6hoh5i7g_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
Friend, For more than two decades, American Veterans Center has been dedicated to honoring the sacrifice and preserving the legacy of our nation's heroes. Each year, we host the **National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** , bringing Americans together in a powerful display of remembrance and patriotism. We also proudly produce **" American Valor: A Salute to Our Heroes,"** a nationally televised tribute to the men and women who have served across generations.

But our work goes far beyond public events. At the heart of our mission is a commitment to **preserve the stories of veterans from every era of service** -- from the final voices of World War II, to those who served in Korea, Vietnam, and the post-9/11 generation. Through these efforts, we ensure that future generations understand the cost of freedom and the courage it has taken to defend it.

This year, American Veterans Center is marking historic military milestones: the 250th anniversaries of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps...the 80th anniversary of the victories that won World War II...and key events in the Korean War 75 years ago, and the Vietnam War which ended 50 years ago this year.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5daik9i1cqdbqp6ifkgbohilfn1qne9ea71e9lg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
**We may never have another opportunity like this to recognize their sacrifice on a national scale.**

[**To mark the occasion, I want to send you a full-size (3x5ft) American flag when you make a gift of $25, $50, $100 or more to support the American Veterans Center 's historic campaign: American Honor 2025.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z2r8kcvf7bl73rg8167cnhihiemcsvi2hifc76a0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
[ **Claim Your FREE Flag Today**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zgpqv16j3dj87geesj71gv2avgec0bo1npuftu2o_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
This is one of our most ambitious efforts ever, Friend -- a national salute to those who fought to make and keep America free.

**Together, we 're capturing the stories of WWII veterans before it's too late...and preserving seldom-heard accounts from those who fought in Korea, Vietnam, and the post-9/11 wars.**

And with your gift today, I'll send you a free, full-size American flag as my thank you.

To some, it may look like just a flag.

_But to those who served, it 's a promise kept._

It flew over the beaches of Normandy.

It sailed with the Pacific fleet.

It was stitched into the sleeves of every soldier who never made it home.

**This flag reminds us of all they sacrificed, and what we 're now called to defend.**

Let it fly proudly as a reminder that freedom isn't free -- and that this generation will not forget the sacrifices of the last.

[**So please, Friend, make your gift today. Help us preserve their legacy while there's still time -- and proudly fly the flag they fought for.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zdd2v9qmv8mbm89l8c8k073s9rcsl7tk2vje017o_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
[ **Claim Your Free Flag Today**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zhql4fuee66mqf55vbf23k3lus3airb52g0mess8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---
Friend, throughout American history, our nation's flag has stood tall.

**I hope you 'll take this opportunity to receive your American flag and fly it proudly, today and every day as a symbol AND promise of freedom.**

Thank you for standing with America's heroes -- past, present, and future.
---
Sincerely,

Tim Holbert
President
American Veterans Center
---
[ **Support the American Veterans Center**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z4cvvarrv9jaohldtrjmujkmbjmsj7ui1jqlvjbg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4c3im1p76clh2bs)
---

Hi, human person! 🐶
_WOOF!!_ It's me! **Bailey, the campaign dog**!
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/41ba67b5-5cb2-4664-bc74-c9ed3becd3d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Great to meet you! A bit about me: I'm a very good girl, big fan of trees (especially in the UP 🌲), a semi-professional napper, and the unofficial mascot of Team Haley.
My mom, Katelyn, is Haley Stevens' finance director, which means she spends a lot of time looking at screens and saying things like "Q4 projections." Blah blah blah - I JUST WANT PETS! 🐾 Sometimes, I gently remind her that belly rubs are just as important as fundraising goals. Self-care, mom!
Anyway - I've got my paw on the pulse of this campaign! And I'm here to share my dog-perspective of Haley Stevens for Michigan!
Coming to you LIVE, two feet from the ground and on all fours! 🦮 This is:
#### **A Campaign Dog 's-Eye View of Democracy**
You might think I spend all day chewing squeaky toys and chasing squirrels (yes, I do that too, and I have no regrets), but I also get to see what's happening out here on the campaign trail. I've been in the background on Zoom calls, sniffed at least 900 voters, and been in all the meetings (I'm excellent at going from person to person looking for pets). Here's what I've picked up:
🐾 **Michigan is one of the biggest Senate races in the country.
** Everyone's barking about it. This race is going to be close, and it's going to be tough - but us underdogs? We don't back down.
🐾 **Haley has the best shot of any Democrat to win.
** That's not just me saying it (but I am biased because she always scratches my ears _juuuuust_ right). The polls say it too! Voters across Michigan know Haley is the best - she's from here, she's worked her tail off for working families, and she knows all the best spots for Detroit-style pizza! (BUDDYS! Yum.)
🐾 **Haley is loyal, scrappy, and loves Michiganders
** Just like me! But while my passion is stealing a sniff of my mom's Coney dog when she's looking at her phone, Haley is all about protecting Michigan jobs - she even helped lead the auto rescue way back in 2009. I've seen her prepping for speeches while eating lunch in the car, meeting with tons of voters at events all day, walking picket lines with unions, and still remembering to give me a treat when she gets back to HQ. That's dedication. And great snack awareness. (Honestly, an underrated quality in a senator, IMO.)
I love being a Haley Stevens campaign dog. I get to be part of something hopeful and exciting, and I can see that humans are excited about Haley, too! I know this is going to be a tough race, but it is my official opinion that Haley Stevens would be an awesome senator.
So that's the paw-litical rundown!
There will be another update soon, but until then, I'll be doing my part - giving love to staffers and volunteers and reminding Haley about snacks and sitting patiently during long calls. 🐾
Thanks for following along! And if you see me out on the trail, come say hi! I love meeting Michiganders (especially the ones who smell like Coney dogs...)
XOXO,
Bailey 🐶
(_on behalf of my mom Katelyn, Haley, and the whole Team Haley pack)_

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/157e7641-498c-48fd-9273-10f7c913935b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This isn't rocket science, but Republicans just don't care. Peter,

Donald Trump is throwing 15 million Americans off their health care and doubling premiums for another 20 million families. On top of that, he's outright refusing to use emergency funding that could extend SNAP benefits during the government shutdown.

To add insult to injury, the administration threw a banner across the U.S. Department of Agriculture's website on Saturday, stating "the well has run dry," and blaming Democrats for the shutdown.

While families here in St. Louis County are choosing between paying for groceries or prescription drugs, **Trump and Mike Johnson are making sure the top 1% gets to keep their $1 trillion in tax breaks.** When you've got families rationing insulin and parents skipping meals so their kids can eat, it's cruel, plain and simple.

**Peter, this is what happens when the party in control of the White House chooses to work for the wealthy few instead of the American people.** But we have a choice, too. We can choose to build a government that actually works for working families, protects health care, puts food on the table, and invests in people. But it _really_ is going to take all of us stepping up.

|
Peter,
The Pennsylvania Supreme Court election, once an obscure and sleepy affair, has escalated into an all out national fight. Tens of millions have been spent by both sides and on the ground it is hand to hand.
The far-right is jockeying to turn this court into a decisive advantage over Democrats and aims to use it to uphold an extreme abortion ban, a full redistrict of the PA congressional map, and to rig the 2026 midterms and 2028 presidential where Trump will seek a third term.
The stakes are life or death.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XLOnvSMgYm7DzOISrWjU0jEYp_cymjeGHNZAfRizJWXqnpFooe5NVN8Js2VdYwInGqQn82m4wLqNvIMtsXwB0HUTNmHgYIndFk-0ERgQHhxUOjXy0vAZtiY623-BLd6WSSj7tvVlg2aIuxCmaw_jUwELVCzeynrXHavRyksblLyq4bj-BlxZFXaMXETBwiEo1lEpcyfAmh4hxF5UCIiZtYuUggwOLPeXkvgwlH3h6N8=&c=VttJHEhTZstASXQG0gUlalkRXdRyuS5Ird8RHeFShMum2yu76a2xyQ==&ch=fxWWEp6G3jhgiSK8Y6F7vbZEjpkOPYY-jESHXuNYlLEyZWowaOwPdQ==)
---
To win this race the GOP has unleashed an unprecedented dirty tricks campaign comprised of deceptive mailers, ads, and now even canvassing efforts, that aim to convince Democrats and Independents to vote for the Republican ballot choices.
Because the Judges appear without partisan affiliation MAGA's ads and mailers use using pro-choice adjacent language into convincing that a no vote (the GOP ballot option) will "protect women"
To combat this, Defend our Courts is doubling down on making it crystal clear to voters that voting YES is the only way to protect women. This week Spotlight PA took notice:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XLOnvSMgYm7DzOISrWjU0jEYp_cymjeGHNZAfRizJWXqnpFooe5NVN8Js2VdYwInGqQn82m4wLqNvIMtsXwB0HUTNmHgYIndFk-0ERgQHhxUOjXy0vAZtiY623-BLd6WSSj7tvVlg2aIuxCmaw_jUwELVCzeynrXHavRyksblLyq4bj-BlxZFXaMXETBwiEo1lEpcyfAmh4hxF5UCIiZtedIGKwhQsSTkWPspsQEwGs=&c=VttJHEhTZstASXQG0gUlalkRXdRyuS5Ird8RHeFShMum2yu76a2xyQ==&ch=fxWWEp6G3jhgiSK8Y6F7vbZEjpkOPYY-jESHXuNYlLEyZWowaOwPdQ==)
---
| Unfortunately despite the best efforts of us and our peers, it could all be for nothing.
If the election were held today, there is a very real chance that we would lose it. Polling shows that the GOP's disinformation strategy is working and that many of our voters are confused on whether to vote yes or no.
Defend Our Courts is making a stand and leaving nothing on the table. subject: Lower Drug Prices, EPA and Pesticide Alarms, and Much More— MAHA Media Hub Recap
body:
We’re proud to be on this journey toward better health for our nation with you.

| | | [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=1)

**Attention MAHA Warriors,** This week's MAHA Media Hub call was nothing short of inspiring — inspiring stories, inspiring action, inspiring change.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=s3R0RXQyhIU4uwgp4V2gm6thPtRE_uXB8ZkVa5I1L3mj84A73FWfjlgYPA7J_Iwc5SAbwFxYbJNaGVLkuwwSpA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=2 "STOP CHEMICAL IMMUNITY") [STOP CHEMICAL IMMUNITY](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=s3R0RXQyhIU4uwgp4V2gm6thPtRE_uXB8ZkVa5I1L3mj84A73FWfjlgYPA7J_Iwc5SAbwFxYbJNaGVLkuwwSpA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=2)
---
### Whether you watched live or not, here’s a quick recap of what you need to know:
* **Dr. Alexandra Munoz** exposed the EPA’s attempt to rewrite TSCA rules in a way that could flood the market with untested chemicals linked to infertility and hormone disruption. Public comments close November 7, and [MAHA is mobilizing to stop it](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=s3R0RXQyhIU4uwgp4V2gm6thPtRE_uXB8ZkVa5I1L3mj84A73FWfjlgYPA7J_Iwc5SAbwFxYbJNaGVLkuwwSpA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=3).
* **Dr. Ben Carson** emphasized the importance of protesting our broken system but said another key step is educating the public so real change can happen.
* **AJ Richards** said a quote every American should hear: “If you pay the farmer now, you’re not going to pay pharma later.” He spoke about the importance of supporting farmers and buying from them directly.
* **Jillian Michaels** reminded everyone that while the media pushes endless culture fights, the real crisis is the poisoning of our food, water, and air — a crisis the political class profits from while Americans pay the price.
* **Dr. Oz** outlined major FDA changes coming that will bring down drug prices and expand access to affordable medicine.

We also heard from **Dr. Aseem Malhotra** , **Russell Brand** , and many others. **🎥 If you want to see the full Media Hub, check it out 👇**
---
[ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=1AJnCcoGtHYftrUTYBwtFNZfyePgR4GaEwlKTaxuNm5yGVZCaVcHVNVcxjgcEp4_wueoeliPUTyF0cKPNi7kJA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=4)
---
## Action Items
### Check Out the MAHA Legislative Tracker
This will be your go-to hub for every MAHA-related bill and policy update. See what’s moving in your state and federally, and take real action to influence change. [Open the Legislative Tracker →](https://www.mahaaction.com/lawmakers?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=5)
### Fight Back Against the EPA’s TSCA Rule Change
The EPA is trying to rewrite TSCA rules to allow more toxic chemicals into our homes, food, and environment. Dr. Alexandra Munoz has sounded the alarm — and we only have until November 7 to speak up. Use the link below to submit a public comment. A quick template is waiting for you inside. [Submit Your Comment →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=s3R0RXQyhIU4uwgp4V2gm6thPtRE_uXB8ZkVa5I1L3mj84A73FWfjlgYPA7J_Iwc5SAbwFxYbJNaGVLkuwwSpA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=6)
### Keep the Pressure On — Stop the Pesticide Immunity Shield
Yes, we’ve been talking about this for weeks — and that’s because Big Chem is counting on us to stop caring. Congress is pushing a Farm Bill that gives chemical companies legal immunity and blocks states from regulating pesticides. Don’t let them win by staying quiet. Call your representatives and demand they reject this immunity deal. [Take Action Here →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=4OpapyABMkIfQDTWg-zeF-UqQSnM47QbJq24ubwJx_0MwgQ3tqwPjcUWmWZRp8Q3&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=7)
### We Are the Media Now
Mainstream outlets can spin headlines — but we’re the ones reaching millions online. Each post, each share, each comment keeps the truth alive. Grab this week’s Media Toolkit and help us lead the charge.
---
| [](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=sjKpYmznzv_7QQp_iae-wBkvzFbQ9W98hCMQv_zWEgc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=8 "DOWNLOAD ALL RESOURCES") [DOWNLOAD ALL RESOURCES](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=sjKpYmznzv_7QQp_iae-wBkvzFbQ9W98hCMQv_zWEgc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=8)
---
### Read and Share The MAHA Report
We’ve gathered some of the most talented writers in the MAHA and medical-freedom space. They work tirelessly to bring you in-depth, timely coverage of the issues that matter most. [Read The MAHA Report on Substack →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=CjIPhRT4CzYYH7usCPIijxK54GDZUZAqQjCCk5hNXuc&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=9)
### Stand for Health Freedom — Take Action This Week
**Where’s the Beef From?**
Support Rep. Thomas Massie’s Country of Origin Labeling Enforcement Act (H.R. 5818) to ensure honest food labeling and stand with American farmers, just as AJ Richards urged.
[Take Action →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaABDKWqP04XOsWpkI2QWC_U7lDelR_lrVoHPRZHAb1eOA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=10) **Stop Playing God with the Sun**
Join Sen. Doug Mastriano’s call to end taxpayer funding for Solar Radiation Modification and stop the government from experimenting with our skies.
[Take Action →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaA-Owj3C41WCminNG1It-Ok&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=11) **Emergency Power, Permanent Harm**
Tell Congress to pass H.R. 4388, the PREP Repeal Act, and end corporate immunity for drug companies once and for all.
[Take Action →](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaChrrjLDUueoykyUHuX36H8Km6NNZYCPSvZ0MqPYzQcLg&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251030_251023&n=12) If you made it all the way to the bottom here, thank you as always for everything that you do. Depending on where you’re located, it might be hard to see the change happening day to day — but make no mistake, week after week, real progress is being made and the driving force behind it all is people like **you**. Keep up the good fight. We’re proud to be on this journey toward better health for our nation with you. See you next week,
**The MAHA Action Team**

**_Donald Trump is planning on attacking payment processor ActBlue in another attempt by his administration to push the limits of his power._**
The detainment of Mahmoud Kahlil, the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and the outright denial to follow a ruling made by the Supreme Court are all blatant oversteps that attack our right to free speech and due process and challenge the rule of law.
Friend, I've spent years watching Fox News and listening to their rhetoric get more and more extreme, and Donald Trump is doing exactly what they want.
**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**
As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
And Friend, that's what this action on ActBlue is: retaliation. Campaigns like ours rely on small dollars from people like you to support us, and ActBlue is integral to making that work.

# Scott Bessent unloads on senate Democrats for gov't shutdown "failure"
In a **[blistering post on X](https://substack.com/redirect/119505cf-cd4a-4c62-8fa4-905195d965e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent took Democrat Senators Elizabeth Warren and Amy Klobuchar to the woodshed for refusing to reopen the government and for their economic incompetence, calling the pair "failures."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1e9d947f-1629-473c-98fa-b4dde4a37787?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Blames senators for government shutdown harming farmers:** Bessent criticized Senators Warren and Klobuchar for not reopening the government, which he said is preventing aid to American farmers and blocking activation of the Farm Credit Agency, while warning they should be "ashamed" if they vote to keep it closed over Thanksgiving and ruin travel for American families.
* **Criticizes attempt to derail Argentine president:** He continued to say that the senators failed to undermine Argentine President Javier Milei's landslide electoral victory, where "the poorest members of society" voted for "economic freedom," calling Warren the "Senate's resident American Peronist" and contrasting their failures with Trump's successful Asia trip and upcoming "resounding victory" for farmers from his meeting with President Xi.

# Trump and Xi make historic trade deal in South Korea
Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping **[forged a dramatic trade truce](https://substack.com/redirect/242edac2-09c3-4742-ab19-91876f77b08a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday, China will pause rare earth export curbs for a year and the U.S. will cut tariffs from 20% to 10% as China curbs fentanyl ingredient exports staving off a full-blown economic clash.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6864e322-e204-4b8a-b6a2-ebf8869d5787?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rare Earths Paused Yearly** : China halts Oct. 9 export controls for one year; Trump vows routine extensions, settling global supply for semiconductors, EVs, weapons.
* **Tariffs Slashed Immediately** : Fentanyl related duties halved to 10%, dropping overall Chinese goods rate to 47% which averts Trump's threatened 100% hike.
* **Nvidia Exports Unresolved** : Chip talks excluded the advanced Blackwell GPUs but Trump is to arbitrate between Xi and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
* **Agriculture And Shipping** : China will buy 25M tons U.S. soybeans a year and the U.S. and China will each suspend port fees for ships that dock in each others country.

# US Rare Earth stocks surge on news out of South Korea
U.S. **[rare earth stocks surged](https://substack.com/redirect/3c459442-757e-45d8-a892-b84102a0e504?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday after Presidents Trump and Xi clinched a dramatic trade truce in South Korea, with Beijing delaying new export controls on the vital minerals for one year amid fentanyl tariff cuts.
* **Stocks Surge Wildly** : CRML leaps 7%, USAR climbs 6%, UUUU and MP gain 3% in a premarket frenzy.
* **China 's Iron Grip**: China still dominates 70% of rare earth mining, and 90% of rare earth processing but the deal opens the window for US based miners and processors to grow their share.
* **April Curbs Linger** : Earlier restrictions on seven rare earths, magnets stay firmly enforced.

# A tale of two AI earnings reports, Google soars, Meta tanks
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da4fa939-6e28-4f7a-aac7-f581ab4c4204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Alphabet's shares **[rocketed 4%](https://substack.com/redirect/58837d57-b2aa-4db3-a35d-5946bd9589b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday after the tech giant smashed Wall Street estimates with record Q3 revenue topping $100 billion for the first time, fueled by roaring ad sales and AI-charged cloud demand.
* **Q3 Earnings Crush Forecasts:** Google's results of $3.10 adj. earnings per share and $102.35B revenue--beats the $2.33/$99.89B estimates. Search revenue was also up, leaping 15% to $56.56B.
* **Cloud Backlog Booms Massive:** Google Cloud hits $155B backlog, while revenue surges 34% on the markets frenzy for all things AI.
* **AI Capital Xxpenditure Skyrockets Boldly:** In 2025 investment in AI surged to $91-93B. The expectation is that there will be a "significant" 2026 jump as the AI war escalates.
* **Analysts Cheer AI Dominance:** Analysts now see a price targets on Google's shares of $340 as AI flips the threat to Google search into an epic opportunity.

Meta Platforms' shares **[plunged more than 10%](https://substack.com/redirect/5d6b52de-ac60-4c54-9a19-37712379de54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday after blockbuster Q3 earnings, as investors recoiled from the tech giant's raised $70 billion-plus AI spending forecast despite CEO Mark Zuckerberg's fierce defense of future "superintelligence" gains.
* **AI Capex Skyrockets Higher** : Meta upped its 2025 guidance to $70-72 billion from $66-72 billion, fueling data centers and tools amid fierce competition.
* **Zuck Bets Superintelligence** : Meta is aggressively building AI capacity for what it sees as a "generational paradigm shift."
* **Scale AI Mega-Investment** : As part of its investment in AI Meta's acquired Scale AI at a cost of $14.3 billion on startup, hiring CEO Wang for the new Superintelligence Labs.
* **2026 Spending Explodes** : The expectation is that investment in 2026 will be "notably larger" than 2025, with AI talent hires driving massive expenses.

* * *
* * *
# Fed cuts rates by 0.25% but warns a December cut **" is not a foregone conclusion"**
The Federal Reserve **[slashed interest rates](https://substack.com/redirect/5332cb9a-360a-495c-a33f-bd72bb9bc67e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by a quarter-point to 3.75%-4% Wednesday--its second cut this year-- but Fed Chair Jerome Powell stunned markets with a warning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5332cb9a-360a-495c-a33f-bd72bb9bc67e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Split 10-2 vote reveals** : Dissents from Gov. Miran (who wanted a 50bps cut) and Kansas City Fed's Schmid (who preferred a hold).
* **Yields Surge Dramatically** : 10-year jumps 7 bps to 4.054%, 2-year leaps 9 bps to 3.582%, 30-year climbs 5 bps to 4.598%.
* **QT Ends December 1** : Fed halts $5B monthly Treasury runoff, caps MBS reinvestments at $35B to avert liquidity crunch.
* **Shutdown cripples data** : Due to the Democrat shutdown of the government, the Fed had to make it's decision without the usual economic data reports that it uses and the decision reflects more concern about jobs risks than inflation and elevated prices.
* **Markets reel sharply** : Chair Powell warned a December cut "is not a foregone conclusion" causing markets to dip and the odds of a December rate cut to drop to 67% based on Powell's hawkish tone.

name: Wes Moore
subject: I refuse to stand by while the government makes it harder to put food on the table
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=847%2E1086043%2ESLBy5L)
Peter, this morning I was at the Anne Arundel County Food Bank. It’s one of a handful of food pantries I’ve visited during this prolonged government shutdown.
And – while I am thankful to see how our public servants are stepping up across the state to show love to their communities in this moment – the cruelty that we are seeing from the Trump Administration is undeniable.
Nearly 700,000 Marylanders – including over 270,000 children and 120,000 older adults – are set to lose access to food assistance tomorrow because of the Trump administration’s withholding of emergency funds.
But we refuse to stand by while the federal government makes it harder to put Marylanders food on the table. **That’s why today I declared a state of emergency to move $10 million in emergency funding to our food assistance partners across the state.**
While the President’s focus is building a $300 million ballroom to host lavish parties for his billionaire buddies, ours is keeping roofs over our federal workers’ heads. It’s keeping our most vulnerable fed. And ensuring that those who raise their hand to serve are treated with the dignity they deserve. Because in Maryland, we leave no one behind.
In moments like this, a little bit of help can go a long way. The state cannot close the gap of federal programs like SNAP, WIC, and TANF alone. So I have to ask:
**[If you’re able to, will you join me in helping Marylanders by chipping in whatever you can to the Maryland Food Bank today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/754?t=4&akid=847%2E1086043%2ESLBy5L)**
Let me be perfectly clear: This administration and national Republicans have the power to make this right. Instead, they’re using the hunger of hundreds of thousands of Marylanders as a bargaining chip. It’s outrageous.
Right now, when it counts, I’m determined to do what I can for Maryland. Thank you for standing with me in that fight.
Elevate,
Wes

Email us: [info@wesmoore.com](mailto:info@wesmoore.com)
BY AUTHORITY: WES MOORE FOR MARYLAND, MARY TYDINGS, TREASURER

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Democracy Docket: New Ruling Cuts Off Key Tool to Protect Minority Voters [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103025_2&amount=25]
Folks: An update from the federal 8th Circuit on one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years .
A federal appeals court recently cut off a key avenue for private groups and individuals to bring racial discrimination claims under the Voting Rights Act (VRA). The ruling, which applies in seven states, further weakens the ability of our civil rights law to protect voters, and could lead to the Supreme Court settling the issue.
This goes back to an initial ruling from 2023, the impact of which is pretty simple to understand: That voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. According to the 8th Circuit, and now confirmed on appeal, only the Department of Justice (DoJ) has the legal standing to sue states over voting laws.
With former Florida AG Pam Bondi -- a "big lie" spreading MAGA acolyte -- serving as Attorney General, it's clear that the DOJ is not going to protect voting rights over the next four years.
Team, we have to fight this ruling and make sure voters and advocacy groups have the right to defend voting rights in court. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can to make every vote count, either at the ballot box or in court >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=103025_2&amount=25]

This is all about the legal term "private right of action". The 8th Circuit says it doesn't exist. That means the pro-voting lawsuits we've seen in states like Wisconsin, Georgia, Florida, and others nationwide wouldn't be possible anymore if the Supreme Court backs up this ruling.
We won’t sugarcoat this: This could be a crushing blow to many voting rights organizations across the country, ourselves included. If this new appellate ruling is not overturned by the Supreme Court, it could unravel all of the great work pro-voting organizations are doing across the country — and allow dozens of unjust, unconstitutional voter restrictions to stand.
Attacks like this on what remains of the Voting Rights Act are going to get worse over the next few years. As voter suppression laws become increasingly targeted and oppressive , our work to combat them must become smarter, stronger, and more accessible to everyone.

subject: One job interview 30 years ago changed my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Weiser for Colorado
body:
Opportunity - see our plans for jobs, education, and our workforce.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324988/579379163/1239926708?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520) Friend, what brought me to Colorado thirty years ago was a job interview. Looking back, that interview proved to be a major turning point in my life. I’m grateful that it led me here, and for all the opportunities I’ve had to build a life here with Heidi and our kids. I want Colorado to be a place of opportunity—where we all can and want to stay, and where our kids can build a future for themselves and their families. That’s why I’m running to be your next governor. After listening to and gaining insights from Coloradans across our state, we put together our plan to fight for our kids' future and the state we all love: **[The Colorado Blueprint.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324989/579379164/971055370?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)** **Below are some highlights of our plans to secure opportunity in Colorado for our kids and their future.** Building a thriving economy that provides opportunities for our kids means that they have access to jobs that pay a livable wage and provide financial security. And to build a thriving economy, we must invest in key building blocks, like public safety, infrastructure (including broadband, water infrastructure, and transportation), homes people can afford, and the protection of our land, air and water. A top investment priority for our future is education and workforce training. | **[Want to jump right into a Blueprint deep dive? Check it out here! >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324990/579379165/971055370?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)**
---
A flagship initiative I will bring to Colorado as our next Governor is **ColoradoCorps** — a brand-new service program for careers in education, law enforcement, nursing, counseling, and firefighting. This program will both address key shortages in critical service professions and empower Coloradans with good-paying jobs at the same time. And it will pay long-term dividends by inspiring Coloradans about how they can make an impact and provide them with a powerful sense of belonging.
**[Learn more about how ColoradoCorps will mean better public services, a stronger sense of belonging for our kids, and a brighter future for everyone in our state >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324991/579379166/971055370?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)**
To expand pathways into good-paying jobs, our Colorado Blueprint calls for several other key initiatives, including:
Under our plan, we’ll
* **Pay teachers livable wages** , so they don’t need to work multiple jobs just to live where they work.
* **Protect against privatizing or profiting off of our public schools.**
* **Support and expand Universal Preschool** to give kids a strong start.
* **Increase access and lower costs to higher education** , so young people can avoid being crushed by debt right at the start of their adult lives.

I am also committed to **supporting Colorado’s workers** , ensuring they are paid and treated fairly, including the right to join a union. As the People’s Lawyer, I’m proud to have stood with workers time and again, from supporting striking workers to protecting the right to unionize to cracking down on wage theft to curbing the use of abusive non-compete agreements. As Governor, you can count on me to keep having our friends’, family’s, and neighbors’ backs when it comes to the fair treatment we all deserve.
**[Creating opportunities for our kids and families is top-of-mind for me because it is critical that we build a Colorado where our kids want to stay. Read more about all the ways the Colorado Blueprint will reinvigorate Colorado’s economy, strengthen our public schools, and provide new training pathways for good jobs. >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324992/579379167/971055370?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)**
Let’s get to work,
Phil
P.S. — If you have comments or suggestions on the Colorado Blueprint, I want to hear them. [Please offer your feedback here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118324993/579379168/94470019?refcode=em_WEI_OTH_ColoradoCorps_103025&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YWY0NGZjMi1iY2I1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DKx4t2KbOZcua4SAN_CvVenqxnV-NorXB3t8l_fOP_I=&emci=2add303b-9bb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4af44fc2-bcb5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=51844520)

name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: What I sent to the White House:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC
body:
SNAP benefits will expire unless they act. |
#
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118325002/579379262/-1313101069?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20251030_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmQyZjgwZTMtYmNiNS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fZvh3480DGfiCxM5-7RDPhNI9t6hnvCpu8YOGt5asvk=) Team, **Federal food assistance benefits, or SNAP, will expire on Saturday unless the federal government takes action.** If they fail to act, millions of Americans will be left facing more hunger and more expenses. _**I refuse to let that happen.**_ So today, I led a group of 21 governors in sounding the alarm, urging that the White House do something about it. Fellow Patriot,
The Virginia governor’s race is razor-thin, with RealClearPolitics showing just a **3% difference** between the candidates in the latest poll. That margin could be as high as **95,700 votes** or as low as **82,800**. The difference between godly leadership and policies that ignore biblical values.

With **5.81 million registered voters** in Virginia, turnout on **November 4** could range from **2.76 to 3.19 million** , depending on whether voters show up like they did in **2017 (47.6%)** or **2021 (54.9%)**. Will they be informed? Will they be guided by faith?

My Faith Votes is focused on reaching **low-propensity Christian voters**. Those who are already registered, but don’t vote consistently, especially in off-year elections like this one. Many simply need a reminder, a reason, and a resource to act. That’s where we come in.

Thanks to our army of Action Partners, we’re already sending over **112,000 letters** to low-propensity Christian voters in Virginia and more are being written every day.

_But we must do more._

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. When we hit our goals, we can confidently budget to organize across all 15 counties, register voters, and have the resources our candidates need to compete. When we fall short, we have to make tough calls about what we can and can't afford. The margins in Arizona are tiny. Katie Hobbs won by less than one percentage point. Kris Mayes won by 280 votes. David Schweikert held on by just 4 points in a district we're targeting to flip. That's not hyperbole — these are literally the margins we're fighting to overcome. And our opponents? They have deep-pocketed donors writing big checks and national Republicans ready to defend their vulnerable members. Meanwhile, we're counting on grassroots supporters chipping in $5, $10, or $25 to keep us competitive. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Arizona Republicans think they can stage shutdown stunts, lie about healthcare, and dodge accountability without consequences. Your support helps us prove them wrong. Thanks so much, Monica Tang Finance team, Arizona Democratic Party = Arizona Democratic Party PO Box 36123 Phoenix, AZ 85067-6123 United States mailto:info@azdem.org | PAID FOR BY THE ARIZONA DEMOCRATIC PARTY. NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. GREG FREEMAN, TREASURER. WWW.AZDEM.ORG

body:
While she fought cancer, a Durango teacher moved in on her child
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎤 **Guess who’s back on the mic?** **Day 7** of the **Douglas County Dirty Dozen** just dropped — and Tori’s turning up the volume on Colorado’s fight for school choice.
The Left tried to block John Adams Academy—a classical charter school teaching great books, Singapore Math, and servant leadership—but parents fought back and won. Now, voters will decide if union-backed candidates opposing school choice take the board this November.
Watch the latest video and follow along on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** In Durango, a heartbreaking story emerged of a mother battling cancer while [losing her daughter to a teacher’s influence](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—reigniting debate over parental rights and gender ideology in schools. In Boulder, a Turning Point USA student leader was attacked after [Antifa-linked groups posted a “hit list”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) online, renewing questions about political violence and the left’s denial of Antifa’s existence. Meanwhile, [AG Phil Weiser filed his 40th lawsuit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) against the Trump administration—this time over frozen SNAP aid. The state says the USDA is withholding billions in contingency funds for struggling families, while federal officials claim their hands are tied until Congress acts.
And in Colorado Springs, [Rampart High senior Sophia Shumaker won](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) the right to repaint her parking spot with a Christian design after officials reversed a policy banning religious imagery—a win for faith-based free speech.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** The [Trump administration reassigned ICE leaders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in five major cities—Denver, L.A., Philadelphia, Phoenix, and San Diego—replacing them with Border Patrol agents in a push to boost deportations before 2026. Meanwhile, Matt Walsh blasted the [“massive scam” of the EBT program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), saying the shutdown exposed rampant welfare dependency as benefits stall for 43 million recipients. And in a surprising shift, Bill Gates walked back [his climate doomsday predictions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), saying global warming “will not lead to humanity’s demise” while still backing innovation over alarmism.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** C.J. Garbo condemned public institutions that elevate unqualified leaders under the guise of diversity—at taxpayers’ expense—arguing that Ian Roberts’ [falsified credentials and illegal status](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) expose a system that rewards identity politics over merit. Meanwhile, Cory Gaines argued that [Colorado’s “green” agenda](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is less about environmental stewardship and more about control, driving costly replacements of efficient technology and expanding government authority.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 30, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[While she fought cancer, a Durango teacher moved in on her child](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

When Colorado mom Cindy Stein sat before state lawmakers last spring, she was still recovering from cancer—and from losing her child to a teacher’s influence in a system that no longer sees parents as essential.
“While I was fighting for my life, this teacher inserted herself into my daughter’s world, convincing her to reject me and her family,” Stein told the Senate Judiciary Committee.
The clip spread quickly online. A month earlier, the Daily Wire broke the story, exposing what she says Durango schools tried to keep quiet.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Government Shutdown Exposes Massive Abuse in EBT System](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY WIRE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Walsh contends that the government shutdown highlighted the extent of Americans’ reliance on SNAP and EBT programs, noting that roughly 43 million people—about one in eight—depend on federal assistance for food.
* He contends that expanded food-stamp spending—up from $4.5 billion in 2019 to $11 billion in 2022—artificially inflates grocery prices and fosters a culture of entitlement among recipients who, he claims, often misuse or exploit benefits.
* The piece highlights alleged abuse by non-citizens and individuals with large EBT balances, arguing that the system rewards corruption and dependency. Walsh calls for abolishing SNAP entirely, claiming it would curb waste and promote responsibility without causing starvation.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[The Case of Ian Roberts: A Slap in the Face to Law-Abiding Citizens](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C.J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Ian Roberts, an undocumented immigrant with a deportation order, was hired and paid nearly $300,000 as superintendent of Iowa’s largest school district, despite falsified credentials and legal violations.
* Garbo argues that diversity and inclusion goals were prioritized over merit and legality, enabling someone with no legal right to work to rise to power while law-abiding citizens face stricter scrutiny.
* The case is described as a symptom of a larger system that rewards deceit and punishes compliance, underscoring the need for institutions that uphold integrity, fairness, and respect for the law.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Faith without votes is dead](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY BERNIE LAKE | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 28** _Christians should engage in the public square. Unfortunately many are unengaged, likely because there’s been a perceived disconnect between the secular and the sacred. But, there is not. Not only is voting in our elections a civic duty, it should be an act shaped by our Christian values._
**[The Marxist roots of America’s racial unrest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY MICHAEL HANCOCK | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 28** _In October 1928, the Communist International — the Moscow-based command center for global revolution — issued an extraordinary directive. Buried in the archives of the Political Secretariat of the Communist International, the document was titled “Resolution on the Negro Question in the United States.” It did not read like a humanitarian plea to end racial injustice. It read like a military plan._
**[Ganahl’s “DougCo Dirty Dozen” puts union power on trial ahead of school board elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 28** With ballots out and school board races underway, Heidi Ganahl has posted six “Douglas County Dirty Dozen” videos asking one question—who sets priorities inside local classrooms? Her focus is the American Federation of Teachers (AFT) and four Douglas County candidates backed by $2,500 donations from AFT Colorado each—proof, she says, that national politics are steering local schools.

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

|
---
**💰 DID YOU KNOW?** **Government shutdowns don’t save money—** they cost it. The 2018–2019 lapse alone shaved $8 billion off U.S. GDP and cost taxpayers millions in back pay to furloughed workers. And while America stalls, most other countries never shut down over budget fights. Countries like Germany and South Korea simply keep operating at last year’s budget until a new one passes.

In 2024, Democratic Sen. Bob Casey lost re-election by 0.22%, or a mere 15,110 votes out of nearly 6.8 million votes cast. Elections in Pennsylvania are routinely decided by razor-thin margins of less than 1%. And this year, three Democrats on the PA Supreme Court are up for retention--or defeat--on the same ballot. Turnout could be the deciding factor in a 50-50 race that will determine control of the state's highest court for years to come. That's why the GOP is using every dirty trick in the book to confuse and scare voters into voting No on retention, a result that would spell disaster for PA and for America as what happens here will ripple out across the country: | == | Every single thing that you do to help move the needle in this unspeakably urgent tossup election could be the difference between a terrible MAGA victory or a huge win for democracy exactly when we need it most. And since the outcome of this race will affect everyone in America, it is imperative that we fight hard and never rest until the bell rings on Election Day and make sure that every last valid vote is counted. We need to prepare right now for two scenarios: 1) We lose, and MAGA sharpens the knives to gut reproductive rights, voting rights, and fair maps in PA, their example serving as a model for every other state; or 2) We win, and the fight is then shifted to the courts (the very thing we are fighting to protect) as MAGA inevitably tries to invalidate the results with baseless claims of election fraud. Defend Our Courts has been preparing for this moment. Together, we are strong. We are ready. Fellow Conservative,

It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota.

The year was 2002, and **the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States.**

**CSI was the top show on network TV,** dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly.

_**DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service.**_

**23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER.**

clean_body: It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota | Fellow Conservative, It’s been a very long time since Republicans won a full six-year Senate term in Minnesota. The year was 2002, and the first season of American Idol had just premiered; Kelly Clarkson wasn’t yet a household name in the United States. CSI was the top show on network TV, dethroning ER from its long-held spot atop the charts, and Everybody Loves Raymond was still airing weekly. DVDs were just beginning to overtake VHS systems in our homes, and Netflix was still in its infancy as a DVD-by-mail rental service. It would be another four years, 2007, before Netflix launched its streaming service. 23 YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH. BUT DEMOCRATS THINK MINNESOTA IS THEIR TERRITORY, NEVER TO BE CEDED TO A REPUBLICAN - EVER. It’s time to send them a message: Time’s up. A poll released recently by one of my opponent’s campaigns has breathed new life into this race - according to their pollster, a generic Republican candidate only trails the Democrats by TWO POINTS. Over the last several months, I’ve been making a concerted effort to introduce myself to you via email and text messages. Have you received and read them? If not, let me quickly reintroduce myself to you today. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks, enlisted after 9/11, and served in over 70 countries, leading high-stakes missions with discipline and resolve. Service is my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for the America we love, the one you’ve worked hard to build for your children and grandchildren. If I can prove to the national Republican party apparatus that I’m a contender who can raise funds independently, they’ll take me seriously and provide the firepower we need to win this race. I need help raising $100,000 by the end of this month, and so far, we’re halfway there. So, The founding fathers didn’t intend for this to be a one-party democracy. There hasn’t been much competition in Minnesota politics lately. I think there is no better person to take on the Democratic establishment than a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. Folks, this is a big win:
A bipartisan majority in the Senate voted to pass my legislation to undo Trump’s tariffs on billions of dollars’ worth of goods from Brazil.
These tariffs were driving up the cost of everyday items like coffee at a time when families are already feeling the squeeze from Trump’s chaotic trade wars and the GOP’s ongoing government shutdown.
The last thing Americans need right now is another self-inflicted economic hit from the Trump Administration.
This vote sends a clear message: the American people don’t want more trade wars, more price hikes, or more chaos.
I’m grateful that my colleagues on both sides of the aisle came together to pass this legislation. It’s proof that we can still make progress for working families — even in the middle of a shutdown.
Now the House of Representatives must take up this bill and finish the job.
We know Trump and his allies will keep pushing for reckless policies that hurt consumers and stall our economy — but I’m going to keep using every legislative tool available to fight back.
If you’re with me, will you chip in any amount tonight to help keep up the fight against this lawless and chaotic agenda? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Families are already paying the price for this shutdown. They shouldn’t have to pay higher prices at the store too.
Let’s keep fighting for stability, common sense, and a government that works for the people.
Thanks for reading,
Tim Kaine

Friend, it's Heidi Hall's team here.
On November 1st, SNAP benefits will officially expire, and almost 5.5 million Californians will be left facing food insecurity.
But was there anything that our politicians could do to stop this?
Yes, actually, there is.
For one, Kevin Kiley, Heidi's Republican opponent, could've been the deciding vote in the House of Representatives to stop Trump's big beautiful bill from passing, and we could've addressed this back then.
Also, Kevin Kiley could've voiced his support for a Democrat-backed SNAP standalone funding bill but has not said a word.
Friend, while he might pay lip service to our communities, it's clear where he stands, with every other Trump-following Republican that's afraid to lose their power if they step out of line.
It's past time we kicked clueless Kevin Kiley out of Congress and elected someone who understands what SNAP benefits, Medicaid funding, and wildfire prevention funding truly mean to our rural communities.

Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

clean_body: [] Friend, it's Heidi Hall's team here. On November 1st, SNAP benefits will officially expire, and almost 5.5 million Californians will be left facing food insecurity. But was there anything that our politicians could do to stop this? Yes, actually, there is. For one, Kevin Kiley, Heidi's Republican opponent, could've been the deciding vote in the House of Representatives to stop Trump's big beautiful bill from passing, and we could've addressed this back then. Also, Kevin Kiley could've voiced his support for a Democrat-backed SNAP standalone funding bill but has not said a word. Friend, while he might pay lip service to our communities, it's clear where he stands, with every other Trump-following Republican that's afraid to lose their power if they step out of line. It's past time we kicked clueless Kevin Kiley out of Congress and elected someone who understands what SNAP benefits, Medicaid funding, and wildfire prevention funding truly mean to our rural communities. If you can, will you donate to Heidi's campaign for Congress today and help us reach our October fundraising goal by raising $6,190 more online before our deadline TOMORROW?
