subject: I was on Stephen Colbert’s show last night.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Honestly, pretty cool.
#

Hey Peter, it's Ruben Gallego.
I was on Stephen Colbert’s show last night.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct25.OOqsxV&refcode=em251030-1-90&t=1&akid=4027%2E734936%2EvmoIYg)
Honestly, pretty cool. I was a kid that grew up poor with a single mom and three sisters, sleeping on the floor of our apartment because there was no bed for me. Statistically, I was way more likely to be on Judge Judy than The Late Show.
My mom did everything she could to put food on the table and keep us safe. I worked all through school to make ends meet. All of us ended up going to college, one of us is a doctor, and I’m a senator.
That’s the American Dream, and it’s something I really believe in.
I also know that dream was out of reach for a lot of people back then. It’s even worse now, with Trump driving up the prices of everything, cutting food stamps, taking away health care, and plundering everything else for himself.
We can do better than this. I know it, and I’m sure you know it.
I really do think the best days for us are still ahead — but we can’t give up. We have to fight, together, for the American Dream. It’s not going to be easy, but I’m all in on that fight.
And if you’re with me, please: [**I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to my campaign before our end of month deadline hits tomorrow. I’ll be out with my kids trick or treating, and it’d give me a lot of peace of mind to know we’re going to hit our goals.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct25.OOqsxV&refcode=em251030-1-90&t=2&akid=4027%2E734936%2EvmoIYg)

clean_body: Honestly, pretty cool. Hey Peter, it's Ruben Gallego. I was on Stephen Colbert’s show last night. Honestly, pretty cool. I was a kid that grew up poor with a single mom and three sisters, sleeping on the floor of our apartment because there was no bed for me. Statistically, I was way more likely to be on Judge Judy than The Late Show. My mom did everything she could to put food on the table and keep us safe. I worked all through school to make ends meet. All of us ended up going to college, one of us is a doctor, and I’m a senator. That’s the American Dream, and it’s something I really believe in. I also know that dream was out of reach for a lot of people back then. It’s even worse now, with Trump driving up the prices of everything, cutting food stamps, taking away health care, and plundering everything else for himself. We can do better than this. I know it, and I’m sure you know it. I really do think the best days for us are still ahead — but we can’t give up. We have to fight, together, for the American Dream. It’s not going to be easy, but I’m all in on that fight. Peter Willis,

Trump isn’t just dismantling our democracy piece by piece – he’s replacing
it with a cruel and power-hungry oligarchy: a government run by
billionaires, for billionaires, at the expense of everyone else.

Bernie founded Our Revolution nearly a decade ago to build progressive
power from the bottom up and take on corporate greed everywhere it hides.
Since then, our grassroots army has helped elect over 1,000 progressives
at every level of government. And right now, as Trump doubles down, our
work is more important than ever.

Our Revolution is rapidly scaling up to meet this moment, growing our
Citizen Action Team, organizing to win crucial elections, and building a
united front to break up corporate power and fight for working families —
work that will continue long after Trump.

We’ve partnered with [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34575?t=1011&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]FreeWill to offer you free, trusted online tools
to help you with your planning.

Here are a few steps you can take to create a plan that protects what
matters most:

1. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34575?t=1012&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]Make your will to designate trusted guardians for children and
pets, ensure your assets will go to those you choose, and gain peace
of mind. It only takes 20 minutes.
2. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34576?t=1013&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]Name beneficiaries for assets outside of your will, such as an IRA,
401(k), or life-insurance policy.
3. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34577?t=1014&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]Appoint someone to make healthcare decisions on your behalf if you
are unable to do so.
4. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34578?t=1015&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]Choose and record someone to manage your finances if you ever
become unable to do so yourself.
5. Optional: Build a legacy to support the organizations you care about,
like Our Revolution.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34575?t=1016&akid=9764%2E5885482%2E05kMB_ ]Make My Plan

Together, we are methodically building the progressive power we need to
transform our country. By engaging in state and local races that too often
get ignored, we are creating the infrastructure of power needed at all
levels of government. By mobilizing the grassroots to demand better of our
elected officials, we are winning fights and showing the strength of our
movement.

But the fact is that all these fights take resources, and you can help
ensure our work will continue long into the future by including a gift to
Our Revolution in your will. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to
reach out to [ mailto:freewill@ourrevolution.com ]freewill@ourrevolution.com.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

name: John Pierce
subject: A Rare Chance to Right a Wrong—Help a Vet and His Family Now!
body:
We’ve got breaking news in Travis's fight for justice — a game-changer.
NCLU just won a historic and critically important victory: The court just granted our motion to lift the protective order that shrouded most J6 discovery in a veil of secrecy.
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e19001747/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNkI2VVdFU1dhZQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTEwMzA/LbmNsa05CU3ZqNg/qP2hpZHM9bmNYTUFTcmdORlhwTVBscw/gaQPsIA/s9ga2600f40)

[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Dear Patriot,

We’ve got **breaking news** in Travis's fight for justice — a game-changer.

Since my last email, Travis has scored a **significant legal victory** : a judge confirmed that he has exhausted all standard legal options to overturn his wrongful conviction.

This opens the door to a **rare legal maneuver** called a **Writ of Coram Nobis** —a tool so uncommon that it's been used **only 3 times in West Virginia history**.

Travis’s case is **rock solid, and we’re ready to seize this moment to clear his name**.

I’m John Pierce, and at the **National Constitutional Law Union (NCLU)** , we’re doubling down to help this veteran reclaim his life after corrupt local officials in West Virginia—abusing their titles, uniforms, and robes—stole his career, his security clearance, and his family’s future.

But this isn’t just about Travis. **It’s about exposing corruption wherever it festers and standing up for families across America harmed by malicious and politically motivated prosecutions**.

**[**DONATE TODAY TO HELP THIS YOUNG VETERAN AND OTHER FAMILIES!**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

A Writ of Coram Nobis is a **once-in-a-lifetime opportunity** to correct a grave injustice, but it’s a heavy lift.

We need **private investigators** , **expert witnesses** , and every legal resource in our arsenal to take on a corrupt judge, complicit cops, and an entire sheriff’s office determined to cover their tracks.

**[**This is where you come in.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

Your donation today will fuel our fight to:

* **Uncover hidden evidence** of the backroom dealings that led to Travis’s wrongful conviction.

* **Challenge the corrupt officials** who thought they could hide behind their authority.

* **Restore hope** to Travis, his wife, and his two young boys, who deserve a future free from this nightmare.

**Corruption has no place in government** , and NCLU is committed to rooting it out, no matter where it hides.

By supporting Travis, you’re sending a message to every arrogant official who believes they’re untouchable: **justice will prevail**.

[**Please,**donate now** to help Travis seize this rare chance to clear his name and rebuild his life**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.).

Every dollar brings us closer to holding these corrupt officials accountable and protecting other families from similar injustices.

**We’re stronger together.**

For Justice,
John M. Pierce
Harvard Law ‘00, NCLU Founder

**P.S.** When Travis heard about his legal breakthrough, **I heard hope reignite in his voice** —a spark of the man he was before corrupt officials tried to break him. Let’s keep that fire burning. [**Please donate today to help us win this fight for him and countless others**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.).

---

**This week, it happened again.**

Alongside Reps. Sara Jacobs and Mike Levin, we returned to the courthouse to demand answers. Once again, ICE officials blocked our entry – denying access to four members of Congress who have both the right and the responsibility to conduct oversight.

We’ve heard deeply troubling reports of detainees being held for days on end, without beds, privacy, or showers – some after simply showing up for routine immigration check-ins.

**These are not dangerous criminals. They are parents, caregivers, and community members – and they deserve to be treated with dignity.**

The cruelty and secrecy we’re seeing are unacceptable. I’m fighting for transparency and humane treatment for everyone in federal custody – but I need your help to keep pushing back against this culture of impunity and obstruction.

---|---|---
**Hey folks, Cliff here.**
And let me start by saying--David Shuster absolutely crushed it today. [The guy is a pro's pro](https://substack.com/redirect/2966b79a-ef56-4541-a162-7dc2aed7de28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While I'm ranting about Trump's tariffs, candy prices, and Clarence Thomas's porn habits (all true, sadly), Shuster's the one keeping this circus from [turning into ](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d53c-fd73-49b4-94d4-61e0cbeac83a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_**[Hardball with a hangover](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d53c-fd73-49b4-94d4-61e0cbeac83a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**._
His clarity, his data, his ability to connect the dots between Trump's tantrums and your grocery bill--it's why I love doing this show with him.
* * *
Honk if you like candy. Oh, also subscribe!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.tnFbt9QpC7WZ3O45s5ePQolRB_iTqwPyJZx_3zxwIlY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=177583295)
* * *
But the real fireworks came when our guest, Tony Michaels, joined the conversation.
Tony is one of those rare Democrats who can talk about working-class America not like an anthropologist, but like someone who _is_ the working class. The man doesn't just get the politics; he gets the people.
And today he dropped a masterclass on how we lost our way--and how we can get it back. How we advocate for what we support, [and how we mock the insanity of MAGA](https://substack.com/redirect/89274bad-79f0-4e90-8373-9803eeed090c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2966b79a-ef56-4541-a162-7dc2aed7de28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tony started with something that seems simple but cuts deep: stop calling it SNAP. Call it what it is--the _food bill._
Because when you sterilize language, you sterilize empathy. You turn hungry families into "data points." He told us there are parents right now worried about feeding their kids--some who will literally be trick-or-treating for dinner because
Trump's cruelty machine decided to cut off food aid. That's not abstract; [that's evil that should be called out as such](https://substack.com/redirect/89274bad-79f0-4e90-8373-9803eeed090c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
From there, Tony dug into his theory of what he calls _the Great Realignment._ The idea is that we're living through a generational shift away from concentrated executive power--what he calls our "Article II addiction"--back toward the people's branch: **Congress, Article I.**
For decades, both parties have leaned on presidents to fix what nearly all Republican--and a few too many Democratic--lawmakers were too cowardly or corrupt to fix themselves. Bush abused it for war, Obama out of necessity, as Republicans filibustered everything.
Trump for pure fascist impulse. And now? Americans are waking up to the cost of kings.
Tony's point hit me hard: [if we want to save democracy, we have to ](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d53c-fd73-49b4-94d4-61e0cbeac83a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[democratize](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d53c-fd73-49b4-94d4-61e0cbeac83a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ it again](https://substack.com/redirect/6af5d53c-fd73-49b4-94d4-61e0cbeac83a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That means ending Citizens United, smashing the filibuster, expanding representation for D.C., Puerto Rico, and the territories, and making sure Congress actually reflects the country--not a bunch of guys from cow-heavy zip codes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89274bad-79f0-4e90-8373-9803eeed090c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
He and I may differ on pace, but on principle, we're dead aligned: power must be diffuse,[ it can't rest in the hands of one arbitrarily elected (especially these days) leader and his billionaire buds](https://substack.com/redirect/5371ee03-c6f2-4088-9769-ef9e5b942db6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And it's not just constitutional theory--it's economics, it's morality. Every SNAP dollar generates $1.80 in the economy and sends 23 cents straight to American farmers. You want "America First"? Feed America first.
Tony nailed it: **[the fight for food, fairness, and freedom are all the same fight](https://substack.com/redirect/5371ee03-c6f2-4088-9769-ef9e5b942db6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
So yeah--huge thanks to Tony Michaels. The guy's building a movement rooted in the working class, the Constitution, and plain decency. Follow him on Substack at _The Coffman Chronicles_ and on YouTube at _The Tony Michaels Show._
[And follow David Shuster everywhere you possibly can](https://substack.com/redirect/2966b79a-ef56-4541-a162-7dc2aed7de28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (but not, like, into his home).

Subscribe for free if you can't pay; go paid if you can.
Because as Tony reminded us: no kings, no dictators--just citizens who still give a damn.

💀 **STANSBURY EMBARRASSED ON CNN**
The facts are simple: Republicans passed a bill to reopen the government 13 TIMES. Stansbury voted NO. New Mexico senators Martin Heinrich and Ben Ray Luján voted NO 13 times.
Democrats need just 5 more votes to hit 60 and reopen the government.
Jake Tapper kept asking: "Why don't you call YOUR senators and ask them to reopen it?"
She couldn't answer. Instead she blamed Trump, blamed the White House, and accused them of "withholding funds from children." Tapper had to correct her multiple times that Senate Democrats can solve this TODAY.

---
| |
🌍 **BILL GATES ABANDONS CLIMATE DOOMSDAY**
Days after we said the climate debate is over, Bill Gates released a memo saying:
✅ "Climate change will not lead to humanity's demise"
✅ Stop the doomsday messaging - it's wrong
✅ Focus on human flourishing, not emissions obsession
This is MASSIVE. Gates is the godfather of climate alarmism. Four years after publishing "How to Avoid a Climate Disaster," he's saying exactly what we predicted.
The New York Times is melting down and blaming Trump. Because apparently Trump can intimidate a man worth $122 billion.

🚨 **NM LAWMAKER'S DANGEROUS ICE TRACKING SITE**
State Rep Marianna Anaya launched a website to track ICE locations. She claims it's to "verify videos."
We went on the site. Found live updates posted TODAY: "6 black SUVs staging behind Walmart." Push notifications alert users in real time.
This gives criminals like Francisco Galvez (the stash house kidnapper) advance warning. Violence against ICE agents is up 400-1000%. This is why.
KOB ran the story without fact-checking anything.
